speaker: Mom
text: Look at you two! Remember, if your Alienmon get tired, the Recovery Bay heals them for free.

speaker: Mom
text: And call home once in a while, Linker.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: The Starfall Crater glows purple again. Something down there is stirring.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: Bring me news from every world you visit. And take care of your partner.

speaker: Lab aide
text: Lab aide: Dr. Vashti tracks every seedpod that fell twenty years ago. There are still hundreds unaccounted for.

speaker: Lab aide
text: Lab aide: The big telescope points at the Starfall Crater. It's been glowing purple again.

speaker: Bram
text: Sola's always at the Trading Post. If she says she's waiting for you, she means a battle!

speaker: Bram
text: The drift grass crackles with blue sparks. That's how you know Alienmon are hiding in it!

speaker: Mr. Abernathy
text: Honey rolls, fresh out of the oven! First one's free for anybody with a brand-new partner.

speaker: Mr. Abernathy
text: I've baked for Dustmere since before the Starfall. Never once burned a loaf. ...Well. Once.

speaker: Girl
text: This is my Pebblet! It's a rock. It's my best friend. Both!

speaker: Girl
text: When it's sleepy it rolls into the shade. When it's happy it rolls into ME.

speaker: Girl
text: DX-4 keeps wandering off toward the bridge. Pebblet follows him. I follow Pebblet.

speaker: Linker
text: Press START to check your team. A tired Alienmon is a fainted Alienmon waiting to happen.

speaker: Woman
text: The shop dome sells Stasis Pods. You can't catch anything without them!

speaker: Woman
text: Weaken an Alienmon first. A full-health one just pops right back out.

speaker: Watchman
text: West of here is the landing pad. Ships only leave with launch clearance from a Keeper.

speaker: DX-4
text: Bzzt! Scout unit DX-4 online.

speaker: DX-4
text: The bridge crosses the canyon to the east trading post. Mind the lava falls!

speaker: Dusty
text: Name's Dusty. I've lived on this rim since the Starfall.

speaker: Dusty
text: That crater past the falls? The seedpods came down hot as stars twenty years back.

speaker: Kit Briggs
text: I'm keeper of the Shards now. ...Okay, I gave myself that job. But somebody has to!

speaker: Kit Briggs
text: Dad gave me his old welding goggles. They're too big. I'm keeping them.

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Recovery Bay! Step up to the counter and I'll heal your team.

speaker: Trainer
text: I come here after every route. Healing is free, so there's no excuse to push your luck.

speaker: Shopkeeper
text: Talk to me at the counter for pods and potions!

speaker: Shopper
text: Gels heal, Cure Spray fixes poison and burns. I always carry both.

speaker: Hiker
text: Don't look down. That canyon goes all the way to the old lava falls.

speaker: technician
text: Bridge keeper: This bridge was built by Ferrox steelworkers. Not a single rivet has slipped in forty years.

speaker: Snack trader
text: Snack trader: Battle snacks! Get your battle snacks! Roasted cactus nuts, still crackling!

speaker: Trader
text: Everything here came over the Molten Frontier on a cart. Prices reflect the danger!

speaker: Kid
text: The lemonade stand? That was... an accident. Mostly the lamb's fault.

speaker: Miner
text: The Sunset Tunnel past the cactus gardens is the only way through to the Frontier on foot.

speaker: Drifter
text: Sola trains out back every morning. Tough kid. Even tougher partner.

speaker: Linker
text: Trainers on the trail will battle you the moment they spot you. Walk past them if you're feeling brave.

speaker: Referee
text: One-on-one! First partner who can't keep going loses! No hitting trainers, no fighting dirty!

speaker: Referee
text: ...And no knocking over my lemonade stand AGAIN.

speaker: Fenna
text: Spores, roots, a few mushrooms that hum. I trade them for anything shiny.

speaker: Fenna
text: Sporeholm grows mushrooms bigger than houses. Bigger than Dustmere, nearly!

speaker: Hiker
text: The Rimwalk Trail hugs the canyon edge. Great view, terrible place to trip.

speaker: Birdwatcher
text: I've seen Alienmon with wings riding the thermals over the canyon.

speaker: Researcher
text: Different grass patches hold different Alienmon. Try them all!

speaker: Camper
text: If you're low on health, head back to Dustmere. Pride is not a healing item.

speaker: Gardener
text: These cacti store water for months. Some Alienmon nest right inside them.

speaker: Explorer
text: The Sunset Tunnel is just east. Bring light, it's a maze in there.

speaker: Miner
text: Watch your step. The lanterns down here run on crystal shards.

speaker: miner
text: Old miner: You can feel the heat from here. The Molten Frontier is right above us.

speaker: Guard
text: Welcome to the Molten Frontier. Stick to the trails and stay off anything glowing.

speaker: Traveller
text: The ash trail east leads to Palm Isle and Port Ember. Rest up there.

speaker: Guard
text: You're entering the Molten Frontier.

speaker: guard
text: Helix built their forge fortress at the top of the ridge. Watch yourself up there.

speaker: Miner
text: That tunnel runs all the way under the sea to Sunset Canyon.

speaker: miner
text: The ground's been rumbling since Helix started digging.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Ash Trail Part A
speaker: explorer
text: Ash walker: The ash makes everything look grey, but the Alienmon out here are anything but dull.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Ash Trail Part A
speaker: Sporefolk
text: Even here, spores find a way. The red blooms feed on lava heat.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Ash Trail Part B
speaker: Nomad
text: Magma-types love the warm ground. Hydro moves cool them off fast.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Ash Trail Part B
speaker: Geologist
text: These vents breathe every few minutes. Count to ten and you'll see.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Ash Trail Part B
speaker: Bug Catcher Grub
text: Fire bugs! The hottest bugs! Battle me!

speaker: Nurse Coral
text: Welcome to the Palm Isle Recovery Hut! Let me patch your team up.

speaker: Nurse Coral
text: Wait. Is that... R.B. No. 1? That's Wren's badge!

speaker: Nurse Coral
text: I was her apprentice at the Dustmere Recovery Bay the night the stars fell. She taught me everything.

speaker: Nurse Coral
text: You've got her eyes. Come here, let me patch your team up. For Wren.

speaker: Islander
text: Palm Isle is the only green spot for miles. The Recovery Hut here has saved a lot of Linkers.

speaker: sporefolk
text: Fruit picker: Try the fire-coconuts. Crunchy outside, molten inside.

speaker: Explorer
text: The hut here is a Recovery Hut. Rest up before you head into the lava fields.

speaker: explorer
text: Weaken a wild Alienmon with a Tether Pulse, shock it with a Stun Spray, then fire the transfer beam!

speaker: Pilgrim Sol
text: The island spirits test every traveler. Let's battle!

speaker: Sailor
text: The Deep Sea Ferry leaves from the long dock. Only cleared Linkers ride, though.

speaker: technician
text: Dock mechanic: Helix boats have been prowling the harbor. Keep your pods close.

speaker: civilian
text: Fish seller: Fresh from the ember sea! Well... warm from the ember sea.

speaker: guard
text: Harbor guard: Port Ember's been a safe harbor for a hundred years. We intend to keep it that way.

speaker: Linker
text: Every Keeper you beat gives you a Signal Shard. Eight of them and something big happens. Nobody agrees on what.

speaker: Villager
text: Welcome to Port Ember, the last calm shore before the lava fields.

speaker: Mina
text: This hood? It's a shark. Obviously. The fish respect it.

speaker: Mina
text: Cast past the end of the boardwalk and wait. Something on Thalassa always bites back.

speaker: Deckhand
text: Mind the gaps between the planks. The sea down there is hot enough to boil soup.

speaker: Squid Sailor
text: The ferry at the end of this dock sails to the Deep Sea Ruins.

speaker: squidsailor
text: Hop aboard whenever you're ready.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Ridge Path Part A
speaker: Climber
text: The Ridge Path climbs toward the Forge Gate. Helix guards everywhere up there.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Ridge Path Part A
speaker: Researcher Kel
text: Lava-forged Alienmon have incredible stats. Let me show you!

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Ridge Path Part B
speaker: Scout
text: I saw Helix grunts hauling crates toward the fortress. Something's being built in there.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Ridge Path Part B
speaker: Wanderer
text: The paths wind down the ridge to the Forge Gate and the shuttle pad.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Ridge Path Part B
speaker: wanderer
text: Wild Alienmon roam the trails between towns. Keep your team healthy.

speaker: miner
text: Forge worker: The Forge Gate opens toward Ferrox once you've proven yourself.

speaker: guard
text: Gate guard: No clearance, no passage. Those are the rules.

speaker: Dax
text: The gate's mine to guard. Beat me first!

speaker: Refugee
text: Helix took the old forge and turned it into a fortress. We had to leave everything.

speaker: Strand
text: Halt! This forge belongs to the Helix Directive.

speaker: Strand
text: Run along, kid. Come back when you're a real Linker, and maybe I'll bother beating you.

speaker: guard
text: Former Helix worker: Helix is finished. I just want to fix things now.

speaker: Grub
text: Psst. I used to work in that Forge. I know a way in.

speaker: Grub
text: Beat the grunt at the door, then find the control room terminal. The keycard is in there.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Lava Bridges Part A
speaker: technician
text: Bridge tech: These lava bridges are cooled by pumps. If they stop, run.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Lava Bridges Part B
speaker: Linker
text: Almost at the shuttle pad. Ships to the far planets launch from there.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Lava Bridges Part B
speaker: Technician
text: This dish relays every signal in the Frontier.

quest_title: Molten Frontier: Lava Bridges Part B
speaker: technician
text: Lately it keeps catching a pulse from the Starfall crater. Same rhythm, every night.

speaker: technician
text: Pad controller: Shuttles leave when the board says so. The board says 'not yet'.

speaker: guard
text: Helix deserter: I flew shuttles for Helix. Never again. Ask me nothing about the Director.

speaker: Strand
text: Helix shuttles fly from this pad straight to the Starfall Rift.

speaker: strand
text: Whatever they're hauling out there, they don't want anyone to see.

speaker: wanderer
text: Lantern keeper: The Shadow Tunnel leads to Umbra. The dark in there plays tricks on you.

speaker: miner
text: Mine foreman: The Magma Mines run all the way down to Pyros' crust. Hard hats mandatory.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: ...the mountain's heart burns like Ystra's dying sun...

speaker: ystran
text: ...the Magma Mines go deeper than anyone has dared...

speaker: guard
text: Gate guard: Welcome to Ferrox. Mind the rails, the ore carts don't stop for anyone.

speaker: Porter
text: Everything that lands here gets weighed, stamped and argued over. That's Ferrox for you.

speaker: Traveller
text: First time on Ferrox? Rustvale is just east. Best scrap stew in the system.

speaker: Scrapper
text: Everything here is built from junk. Even the Relay Tower.

speaker: miner
text: Rail hand: Alloy-types love the rail yard. Bring something that burns.

speaker: Kid
text: Hank's Alienmon are tough as old boilers!

speaker: Watchman
text: Helix suits were sniffing around the crane yard last night. Hank's not happy.

speaker: wanderer
text: Old welder: Hank Briggs runs the tower at the end of Furnace Ridge. You'll need a Shard's worth of guts to face him.

speaker: Linker
text: Magma moves melt Alloy-types fast. Volt moves just bounce off.

speaker: Kit Briggs
text: Dad says I can fix anything except my own room.

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Rustvale Recovery Bay. Step up to the counter!

speaker: Miner
text: I patch up my Alienmon here after every shift. The nurse doesn't even charge for the soot.

speaker: Shopkeeper
text: Pods, gels, sprays. Talk to me at the counter.

speaker: Customer
text: Stun Spray is a lifesaver on the Scrap Route. Those junk-types hit hard.

speaker: Grub
text: Mind the parts. Half of these are holding the other half together.

speaker: Grub
text: Come back when you've seen a bit more of Ferrox. I might have work for you.

speaker: technician
text: Tower engineer: Hank's apprentices train on this floor. The Keeper waits upstairs.

speaker: technician
text: Dock tech: Ships set down on the pad here. Mirefen Village is just east along the boardwalk.

speaker: explorer
text: Bog hiker: Stay on the planks. The bog looks like moss, but it's mostly water and bad decisions.

speaker: sporefolk
text: Spore tender: Mirefen stands on stilts. When the bog breathes, the whole village sways a little.

speaker: Botanist
text: The mushrooms glow brighter near the tower to the east. Dr. Moor says they're listening.

speaker: explorer
text: Bog hiker: Toxin-types hide in the reed beds. Carry Cure Spray, or the walk home gets long.

speaker: Villager
text: The dome with the cyan cross is the Recovery Bay. Rest up before you head into the marsh.

speaker: Grandmother
text: My grandson swears he was lost in the Mushroom Maze for a whole day. It was an hour.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: I came to hear the Spore Choir at the pools. On still nights the spores hum in harmony.

speaker: strand
text: Man in a white coat: Helix? Never heard of them. I'm just... sampling the mushrooms. For science.

speaker: Traveler
text: The Keeper here guards a Signal Shard. Climb her tower and she'll test you herself.

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Mirefen Recovery Bay. Spore-sick or battle-worn, we'll patch your team up.

speaker: Visitor
text: Healing here is free. Step up to the counter whenever your team is hurting.

speaker: Clerk
text: Stasis Pods, Cure Spray, the works. In spore season the Cure Spray sells out fast.

speaker: Shopper
text: Weaken a wild alien before you throw a Stasis Pod. Healthy ones just pop right back out.

speaker: explorer
text: Lost hiker: I've passed that stone shrine three times. I'm starting to think it follows me.

speaker: researcher
text: Lab aide: Dr. Moor's apprentices guard this floor. Beat them and the stairs to her lab are yours.

speaker: technician
text: Lab aide: Beat Dr. Moor and she'll hand over Sporeholm's Signal Shard. Bring Cure Spray. Trust me.

speaker: Sailor
text: Welcome to Port Saltreach! The fog rolls in every morning, thick as chowder.

speaker: Dockhand
text: Helix boats were circling the harbor again last night. White coats, no flags. Shady.

speaker: Swimmer
text: Hydro types are everywhere here. Bring something with Volt moves and they'll fold fast.

speaker: Net-mender
text: The big dome up top is the Recovery Bay. Rest your Alienmon there, it's free.

speaker: Diver
text: Tall weeds on the coral bars hide wild Alienmon. The shallows are full of them.

speaker: wanderer
text: Old salt: Thalassa's rings throw rainbows on the water at noon. Best view's from the lighthouse.

speaker: Fishmonger
text: Fresh catch! ...No, you can't catch it with a Stasis Pod. It's a fish. It's dead.

speaker: Sailor
text: Lighthouse is east, past the market. The old Captain's Log is still up there.

speaker: Shopper
text: Stock up on Stasis Pods at the docks shop. A weakened Alienmon is easier to catch.

speaker: Mechanic
text: Captain Marsh's tower relays signals for the whole system. Or it did, till Helix came.

speaker: Traveller
text: Keepers guard the Relay Towers. Win and they hand you a Signal Shard.

speaker: guard
text: Harbor guard: Trainers on the routes will spot you if you walk into their line of sight. Be ready.

speaker: Storyteller
text: They say Anchorath sleeps under the sea arch, and the tide turns when it dreams.

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Saltreach Recovery Bay. Your Alienmon will be shipshape in no time.

speaker: Sailor
text: I come here after every storm. Even my Alienmon get seasick, believe it or not.

speaker: Clerk
text: Ahoy! Pods, potions, rope, bait. Everything a Linker needs before the coral route.

speaker: Shopper
text: Status cures are worth it out on the islands. Wild bites sting more than you'd think.

speaker: Deckhand
text: Captain Marsh is upstairs. Helix ripped the core right out of this tower. She's furious.

speaker: guard
text: First mate: The Captain fights with the tide behind her. Volt types might give you a chance.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: The signal is clearer here. Neonis hears everything in the system.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: Keep going, Linker. Every Shard brings us closer to the truth.

speaker: technician
text: Dock tech: Ships land on that orange ring. Stand clear unless you like being flattened.

speaker: technician
text: Dock tech: The whole deck floats on Volt power. If the lights flicker, hold onto something.

speaker: Courier
text: Deliveries are faster across the catwalks. Faster still if your Alienmon can fly.

speaker: Raver
text: First time on Neonis? The city never sleeps. Neither do I, apparently.

speaker: guard
text: Port guard: Helix freighters docked here last week. Paperwork was clean. Too clean, if you ask me.

speaker: researcher
text: Signal researcher: Every Relay Tower picks up the same pulse, every eight seconds. Spooky, right?

speaker: Traveller
text: The dome with the cross is the Recovery Bay. It heals your whole team for free. Use it!

speaker: Mom
text: My son wants to be a DJ like Static. I told him to finish his homework first.

speaker: Raver
text: The whole city hums with Volt energy. Feel it? That buzz in your teeth?

speaker: Coder
text: Every sign in Neonis runs on Alienmon power. They get paid in snacks. Good snacks.

speaker: Courier
text: The Arcade District is east. Trainers there love a surprise battle.

speaker: Tourist
text: Volt types hate ground moves. Remember that before you climb Voltspire.

speaker: civilian
text: Street vendor: Neon noodles! You glow for an hour after eating. Totally safe. Mostly.

speaker: Archivist
text: Signal Shards are said to resonate with each other. Collect them and listen closely.

speaker: strand
text: Suspicious man: Helix? Never heard of it. I just... like dark uniforms. Move along.

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Neonis Recovery Bay! Step up to the counter and we'll recharge your team.

speaker: Raver
text: Three battles in a row at the Arcade. My Alienmon needed a nap. So did I.

speaker: Clerk
text: Welcome to the Neonis Shop! Stasis Pods, potions, all the essentials.

speaker: Shopper
text: Stock up before Voltspire. Static's team hits hard and fast.

speaker: Gamer
text: High score on Star Saucer 3! ...Okay, second highest. A Coder beat me with a macro.

speaker: technician
text: Repair coder: Glitchy Alienmon hide in the static. A weakened one is easier to catch in a Stasis Pod.

speaker: Courier
text: Trainers battle you if you walk into their line of sight. Fight, or sneak around them.

speaker: guard
text: Stage guard: Welcome to Voltspire! The Keeper waits at the top. Heal up before you climb.

speaker: technician
text: Sound tech: Feel that bass? That's the reactor below us. Static tunes it like an instrument.

speaker: Archaeologist
text: Welcome to Glyphos! Mind your step, half this place is underwater at high tide.

speaker: explorer
text: Dig Camp is just east. They've got a Recovery Tent if your team needs patching up.

speaker: squidsailor
text: Ferry hand: The Deep Sea Ferry runs here and back. Nobody else is brave enough to sail these ruins.

speaker: Archaeologist
text: These glyphs tell the Alienmon's story. Read the murals and you'll see.

speaker: researcher
text: Rune scholar: Crystal-types grow in the old courtyards. They love the humming stones.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The obelisks in Glyph Hollow hum when you carry Signal Shards near them.

speaker: Digger
text: We found a whole hall of murals past the Coral Ruins. Took us a month to drain the steps.

speaker: Archaeologist
text: Trainers out on the ruins will spot you if you walk in their line of sight. Be ready.

speaker: civilian
text: Camp cook: No shop out here, friend. Stock up on pods and potions before you ride the ferry.

speaker: researcher
text: Rune scholar: Some Helix folks came asking where the murals were. Wouldn't say why. I didn't like it.

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Recovery Tent! Step up to the pod and I'll heal your team.

speaker: Archaeologist
text: Dust, damp, and angry Alienmon. This tent has saved my dig crew more times than I can count.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The Guardian Stones circle the hollow. Some say they still guard something sleeping.

speaker: Archaeologist
text: The glowing door up the steps leads to the Mural Hall. Go look. Really look.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: This is the Temple of Voices. Long ago the bells up top sang every dawn.

speaker: researcher
text: Rune scholar: Every floor has the same glyph in the floor: a seed with wings. Curious, no?

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The chimes fell silent ages ago. They say a Chimelet's song could wake them.

speaker: researcher
text: Rune scholar: Three murals. A home, a hunger, a mother. Read them left to right.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: If the murals are true, every Alienmon you've met is a refugee. Makes you want to be kinder.

speaker: Miner
text: Cinder Hollow sits on the richest ember seam on Pyros. Also the hottest. Mostly the hottest.

speaker: Smith
text: Magma-types temper their own hides in the vents.

speaker: technician
text: Bring a Hydro-type if you plan to argue with one.

speaker: Cook
text: Nothing beats lava-baked rockroot. Crunchy outside, molten inside. Don't bite too fast.

speaker: wanderer
text: Ash walker: The crater's light still flickers some nights. The old-timers won't look at it.

speaker: miner
text: Old miner: Basalt saw the first pod land, you know. He's been Keeper longer than I've been alive.

speaker: miner
text: Still climbs that tower every morning on those knees.

speaker: Traveler
text: The dome with the cyan cross is the Recovery Bay. Free healing, even for outworlders.

speaker: guard
text: Camp watch: Helix suits came through asking about the deep shafts. We told 'em nothing.

speaker: guard
text: Folks who ask about the deep shafts never want ore.

speaker: Kid
text: I'm gonna catch a Cindermole and ride it down the rail line!

speaker: Kid
text: ...Mom says no.

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Recovery Bay. We'll have your team patched up and cooled down in no time.

speaker: Miner
text: Took a cave-in on B2. My Bouldron caught the worst of it, bless him.

speaker: Clerk
text: Stasis Pods, burn salve, cooling tonics. Everything a Linker needs down the mines.

speaker: Smith
text: Heat-proof Stasis Pods? No such thing, kid. They all hold up fine down there.

speaker: Miner
text: Teo Reyes came down this shaft once, chasing some signal. Folks say his tracks go deeper than ours.

speaker: Geologist
text: These red crystals hum on the same pulse as the crater.

speaker: researcher
text: Signal Shards grow from the same rock, I'd bet my lamp on it.

speaker: miner
text: Deep crew: Furnace Ridge is just above. No Recovery Bay down here, so heal up before you push on.

speaker: guard
text: Tower guard: Basalt's apprentices hold this floor. Beat them and the stairs are yours.

speaker: Researcher
text: Something huge is frozen inside the glacier wall past the caverns.

speaker: researcher
text: We call it the Teeth in the Ice. Nobody sleeps well near it.

speaker: Climber
text: Ice paths are slick. Jump the cracks, don't walk them.

speaker: explorer
text: Aurora Route has frost grass. Wild Alienmon love it.

speaker: technician
text: Radio tech: Our antennas pick up signals from the Starfall Rift.

speaker: technician
text: Lately they pulse in sync with the aurora. Spooky, right?

speaker: Townsfolk
text: The Recovery Bay is the dome with the cyan cross. Heal before the caverns!

speaker: Guard
text: Helix crews keep asking for dig permits. The station keeps saying no.

speaker: guard
text: If you see anyone in a Helix strand-suit near the fossils, tell us.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Keeper Ingrid lives up in Aurora Tower, past the Frozen Falls.

speaker: wanderer
text: Win a Signal Shard from her and you'll have really earned it.

speaker: Mom
text: My kids want to catch a Cryo-type. I said only after their homework thaws.

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Frostmark Recovery Bay. Let's warm your team right up.

speaker: Climber
text: Cold doesn't bother Cryo-types, but everyone else hates the caverns.

speaker: explorer
text: Heal here before you head out. It's a long walk back.

speaker: Clerk
text: Stasis Pods, gels, warm socks. Okay, not socks. Take a look!

speaker: Researcher
text: I buy Stasis Pods by the crate. Cave Alienmon break out a lot.

speaker: Climber
text: Trainers spot you from a few tiles away. Step out of their line if your team is hurt.

speaker: Researcher
text: The aurora isn't just pretty. It carries a signal. We just can't read it yet.

speaker: Strand
text: (quietly) Keep walking. Pell's on the radio, and he notices everything.

speaker: Strand
text: Helix is digging under the Fossil Dig, toward the old Ystran bones. You didn't see me, and I didn't see you.

speaker: Pell
text: Hello again, Rook. This dig site is Helix business.

speaker: Pell
text: Helix doesn't lose things. We just collect them later.

speaker: Miner
text: These crystals sing when you tap them. Don't. The wild ones hear it too.

speaker: Researcher
text: My Alienmon fainted in the cold once. Always carry a Revive Spark down here.

speaker: Climber
text: The stairs above lead to the Fossil Dig. Look closely at those bite marks.

speaker: technician
text: Relay tech: This tower boosts the aurora signal across the whole system.

speaker: technician
text: Ingrid's apprentices will test you on the way up.

speaker: Researcher
text: Ingrid reads ice cores like books. She says the ice remembers the Devourer.

speaker: Guard
text: Keep moving. Visitors aren't supposed to be on this deck.

speaker: Guard
text: Wait, are you a visitor? We don't get visitors. ...Carry on, I guess.

speaker: strand
text: Helix grunt: I signed up for the free uniform. Nobody said it came with toxic cleanup duty.

speaker: strand
text: Helix grunt: Don't tell Admin Vex you saw me napping by the planters.

speaker: Scientist
text: I just run the tests. Don't look at me like that.

speaker: Scientist
text: The medical dome up top heals anyone. Even intruders. Budget cuts hit the ID scanner.

speaker: Engineer
text: The power cores have been running hot all week. Engineering says it's 'within tolerance'.

speaker: Engineer
text: Containment wing is east. Then 2F, then Engineering, then Vex. Not that I told you.

speaker: strand
text: Helix grunt: The cages? Oh, those are... wellness pods. For the Alienmon. Very relaxing pods.

speaker: strand
text: Helix grunt: Toxin types love the green pools here. That's why we keep so many. Probably.

speaker: Guard
text: Labs are in the right dome, barracks in the left. Not that you're allowed in either.

speaker: Guard
text: Grunts spot you from five tiles out. Walk into their line and you WILL be battling.

speaker: Scientist
text: Stasis Pods work best on a weakened Alienmon. Helix just uses bigger cages.

speaker: Scientist
text: The Director keeps asking about Signal Shards. Why does a space station need Relay keys?

speaker: strand
text: Off-duty grunt: This is my bunk. That's my bunk too. The new guy snores, so I took his.

speaker: strand
text: Off-duty grunt: Lights out is at 22:00. Battles are at 22:01. Every night.

speaker: guard
text: Barracks guard: Mess rule one: nobody sits in Admin Vex's chair. Rule two: see rule one.

speaker: researcher
text: Lab tech: Those tanks hold Alienmon from every planet you've visited. We call it 'the collection'.

speaker: researcher
text: Lab tech: Upstairs is Project Rift. Downstairs is everything we can't explain to HR.

speaker: Scientist
text: Toxin types shrug off poison, but Gravity and Psi moves hit them hard. For science.

speaker: Scientist
text: Please don't free the specimens. I'd have to fill out so many forms.

speaker: researcher
text: Senior scientist: The Rift engine needs a Singularity core. Admin Vex holds the only one aboard.

speaker: researcher
text: Senior scientist: Director Thorne says the Rift is a door. I've seen the numbers. It's a mouth.

speaker: technician
text: Lab engineer: Don't touch the blue tank. Or the green ones. Actually, just admire from over there.

speaker: researcher
text: Worried scientist: They cry at night. The Alienmon, I mean. I've put in for a transfer three times.

speaker: technician
text: Cage tech: Admin Bronn has the cage codes. He's been acting... odd lately. Almost sympathetic.

speaker: technician
text: Reactor tech: If the core turns white, run. If it's orange, that's normal. It's always orange.

speaker: technician
text: Reactor tech: Vex's arena is straight up the corridor. Heal first. She plays dirty.

speaker: guard
text: Deck guard: Best view in the galaxy. Shame we only use it to watch for Relay Keepers' ships.

speaker: strand
text: Helix grunt: Sometimes I come up here and wonder if we're the bad guys. Then payday comes.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: I rode the skyliner up from the cloud sea. My ears still haven't popped back.

speaker: technician
text: Dock tech: The airships float on Psi-charged crystals. Don't ask me how. I just polish them.

speaker: Skywatcher
text: Skyreach Plaza is just east. Heal up at the Recovery Bay before the Wind Bridges.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The holo-globe shows all fourteen worlds at once. I found my home world spinning in it.

speaker: Skywatcher
text: The islands float on updrafts. Don't look down. Seriously, don't.

speaker: Mystic
text: The twins see what you'll do before you do it. They told me you'd come today.

speaker: Kid
text: I caught a Psi-type with a Stasis Pod! Weaken them first or the pod just pops open.

speaker: researcher
text: Star scholar: The Sky Temple sits past the Floating Gardens. Echo and Iris guard Halo's Signal Shard.

speaker: guard
text: Plaza guard: Folks in Helix coats kept asking about the temple crystal. Odd questions. I sent them off.

speaker: Climber
text: Trainers on the bridges spot you from five tiles off. Slip past their line of sight if you're tired.

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Skyreach Recovery Bay. Rest your Alienmon, the thin air tires them out.

speaker: Visitor
text: Psi-types hit hard up here. Bring something sturdy, or bring plenty of healing gel.

speaker: Clerk
text: Welcome to Skyreach Supply! Stock up now, there's no shop past the plaza.

speaker: Shopper
text: I always carry spare Stasis Pods. You never know what drifts out of the clouds.

speaker: pilgrim
text: Temple pilgrim: The twins wait upstairs. Their apprentices will test you first.

speaker: Mystic
text: One twin starts a sentence, the other finishes it. Don't let it rattle you.

speaker: Traveller
text: You made it through the Shadow Tunnel? Most folk turn back halfway. Gravewell's just north.

speaker: Scavenger
text: Gravewell was a city once, before it tipped into the sinkhole.

speaker: wanderer
text: Now we just call it home and keep the lanterns full.

speaker: civilian
text: Lantern keeper: Keep to the lanterns. The dark plays tricks.

speaker: civilian
text: If a light goes out behind you, don't turn around. Just walk faster.

speaker: Drifter
text: Void-types only come out where the light can't reach.

speaker: explorer
text: The Sinkhole is full of them. Bring something that hits hard.

speaker: civilian
text: Old woman: The Recovery Bay is the brightest room in town. We go there to feel warm, not just to heal.

speaker: Researcher
text: The black-hole sky pulls on everything here. Even sound falls a little slower.

speaker: strand
text: Helix contractor: Nothing to see here. Just... measuring the sinkhole. For safety.

speaker: strand
text: Move along, Linker.

speaker: Kid
text: My big brother says the well whispers your name if you stand at the edge long enough!

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Gravewell Recovery Bay. We'll have your Alienmon glowing again.

speaker: Diver
text: I came up from Sinkhole B3 with every team member fainted. Heal before every level down.

speaker: Clerk
text: Lantern oil, Stasis Pods, potions. Everything you need to go down and come back up.

speaker: Shopper
text: Stock up on Stasis Pods. Void-types are slippery and slip out of a weak throw.

speaker: Miner
text: B1's the easy floor. Mind the waterfalls; that glow isn't water.

speaker: Explorer
text: I've mapped this level three times. The tunnels never quite match my notes.

speaker: Researcher
text: Ghost and Void readings double every floor down. Whatever is below, it is awake.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The well that whispers... listen. Do you hear it too?

speaker: pilgrim
text: Go around the rift. Never across.

speaker: researcher
text: Lab assistant: The professor left in a hurry years ago. The papers are still exactly where he dropped them.

speaker: guard
text: Tower guard: Keeper Kade waits upstairs. Beat his apprentices first; he only sees challengers who've earned it.

speaker: Tamsin
text: The crater's three levels deep, and the light gets stranger the further down you go.

speaker: Tamsin
text: Thirty years I've looked for the world on my question-mark patch. Maybe it's down there.

speaker: guard
text: Cordon guard: Nobody goes past the fields without a reason. Got one? Fine, just don't die down there.

speaker: civilian
text: Rig worker: Helix left half its drills running when they ran. You can hear them grinding at night.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift seeker: Can you hear it? The crater hums like a heartbeat. Louder every week.

speaker: researcher
text: Star watcher: Crystals here grow overnight. I measured one at breakfast and again at dinner. Twice as big.

speaker: technician
text: Camp tech: The Medic Tent is the dome with the blue cross. Rest your team before the Seedpod Fields.

speaker: wanderer
text: Old hand: Twenty years back the pods fell right here. Every Alienmon you've ever met came from that sky.

speaker: strand
text: Ex-Helix grunt: I scratched the logo off my jacket. Whatever Thorne's building down there, I want no part.

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Medic Tent. Step up to the counter and I'll patch your team right up.

speaker: miner
text: Injured driller: Got clipped by a crystal-type in the fields. Those shells hide more than dust, kid.

speaker: Researcher
text: Each cracked seedpod is a shell something hatched from. Rare Alienmon hide in the pink weeds.

speaker: Hiker
text: Out of Stasis Pods already? Weaken them first - a tired Alienmon is much easier to catch.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: They say an explorer camped here waiting for the light to speak. His tent still stands.

speaker: Wanderer
text: I leave a fresh cup by the fire each time I pass. Somebody should, for whoever comes home.

speaker: researcher
text: Star watcher: Psi and Gravity Alienmon gather near the rim. Bring something sturdy.

speaker: guard
text: Rim guard: The descent's three levels deep. Signal Shards resonate louder the farther down you go.

speaker: Caver
text: Watch the purple cracks. That's not lava, it's starlight. Doesn't burn - just pulls.

speaker: technician
text: Helix tech (lost): My map says the Rift Engine is 'down'. Every tunnel here says 'down'. Help?

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The vortex below is breathing. If the Keepers' Shards ever meant anything, it's here.

speaker: strand
text: Helix grunt: The Director's up at the Engine. Go ahead - I'm not paid enough to stand between you two.

speaker: researcher
text: Shaken scientist: Containment keeps dropping. That thing isn't a power source. It's a door.

speaker: Ace Linker
text: I beat the Quorum once. Then they beat me four times. Heal before every hall.

speaker: Astronomer
text: The thin air up here makes the sky so clear. On a good night you can see the Rift glow.

speaker: guard
text: Summit guard: Only Linkers with all eight Signal Shards ride the lift. Go on, you've earned it.

speaker: Ace Linker
text: Crystal types shrug off hits but crack under heavy blows. Bring something that hits hard.

speaker: Astronomer
text: The dome here was tuned to hear radio stars. Now it mostly hears guitar solos.

speaker: guard
text: Summit guard: Nobody has heard Saga speak. The battle does the talking.

speaker: Ace Linker
text: Gravity moves hit like a landslide. Lighten your team and keep your Pods ready.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: I've got the road, Linker. It's holding. Go and bring her home.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: Kessler's side of the Vortex is safe with me.

speaker: Kit Briggs
text: The lens is Teo's crystal map, ground down layer by layer. Took us three weeks!

speaker: Kit Briggs
text: If this works, we're walking to another world. No pressure.

speaker: guard
text: Summit guard: Prime Linker Orra Venn bonded the very first Alienmon. Show respect, then show your best.

speaker: Astronomer
text: Every Signal Shard you carried lit a world on these charts. Helix wanted the map for itself.

speaker: Archivist
text: Quiet, please. The star charts are older than the Linker League itself.

speaker: Returning echo 1
text: Ystran echo: I remember this place green. Look, the first moss is back on the Arrival Fragment!

speaker: Ystran echo
text: Ystran echo: ...welcome home, children of the stars. Rest by the crystal. It still remembers how to heal.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: Ystran echo: We were a voice once. Now we are only the echo, waiting for someone to listen.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift walker: Every fragment here was one world, once. The bridges are all that hold the pieces in a line.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift walker: Don't look down. There is no down. There's just... more sky.

speaker: Seeker
text: The Alienmon you carry were born here. Watch them. They know the way better than we do.

speaker: Seeker
text: The domes are sealed. Whoever lived in them left in seedpods and never came back.

speaker: Returning echo 2
text: Ystran echo: The floating islands are putting down roots again. Terravox hums when it walks.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift walker: The continents drift a hand's width a day. Cross the bridges while they still meet.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift walker: Gravity types love it out here. Everything floats a little, even your thoughts.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: Terravox carried a forest on its back... these islands were its footsteps.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: ...do you hear the roots? They are still reaching for each other.

speaker: Seeker
text: I came for answers. I found waterfalls that fall forever and never land.

speaker: Seeker
text: Wild Alienmon here are strong. Weaken them first, then throw a Stasis Pod.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift walker: The trainers out here are postgame tough. Heal at the Arrival crystal if you're running low.

speaker: Returning echo 3
text: Ystran echo: Coral is growing in the Drowned Seas. Aquelion says the dreams are happier.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: These were our seas. Aquelion sang over them... now the water drowns the old roads.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: ...the coral still grows. Grief is not the same as ending.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift walker: Hydro types thrive in the drowned basins. Bring something that hits them hard.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift walker: Stick to the sand paths. The water here goes down further than any sea should.

speaker: Seeker
text: The Sun Forge. They say Ignarch kept Ystra's red sun burning from this very pillar.

speaker: Seeker
text: The heat here is old heat. It doesn't burn you. It remembers you.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: When the sun began to die, we fed it everything... and still it dimmed.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: ...go north, into the crystal halls. The light there was ours.

speaker: Saga
text: This was the Choir chamber, where every Ystran sang together. It is an instrument, not a building.

speaker: Saga
text: Gather the echoes. They will come if you call them with the old song.

speaker: Kit Briggs
text: Saga's right. This isn't a building, it's an instrument! A big, broken, beautiful instrument.

speaker: Kit Briggs
text: Give me some time. I can fix this.

speaker: Returning echo 4
text: Ystran echo: The Choir chamber sings on its own now. Every note is one of her children.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift walker: Crystal Ruins. Every pillar is a record. Nobody alive can read them anymore.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift walker: Trainers lurk in these halls. Step into their line of sight and they'll challenge you.

speaker: Tamsin
text: I'm staying on Ystra. There's a whole map room of places nobody has found yet.

speaker: Tamsin
text: A capture isn't taking. It's asking. Same goes for a world, I think.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: ...this was a library. We sang knowledge into crystal so it would outlive us. It did.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: Beyond these halls, the forest sickens. The Devourer's shadow touched it first.

speaker: Kit Briggs
text: Go on. We've got this. Nobody gets left, remember?

speaker: Returning echo 5
text: Ystran echo: The blight is gone. The little shadows sleep in the new leaves.

speaker: Seeker
text: The blight spreads from the void's edge. Leaves turn to glass, then to dust.

speaker: Seeker
text: Some Bio types here still fight the blight. Help them and they might follow you.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift walker: Keep to the path. The blighted brush hides wild Alienmon that strike before you see them.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: ...the trees remember being green. If you listen, they will tell you what green sounded like.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: Past the void lies the Heartroot's crater. First, you must look into the hungry one.

speaker: Seeker
text: Eight Signal Shards held the Rift shut. Now you walk right through it. Strange, isn't it?

speaker: explorer
text: Rift walker: That's it. The Edge of the Void. Something in there breathes when the wind stops.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift walker: Save your strength. Whatever waits on that altar is older than the stars around it.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: The Devourer was never cruel... only hungry, and so very alone.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: ...if you face it, do not hate it. Hate is a kind of hunger too.

speaker: Returning echo 6
text: Ystran echo: Every child came home and stayed itself. That is the whole legend. Thank you, Unifier.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: Her world-tree stood here once. Every seedpod that crossed the stars was a piece of her. Now only the Heartroot remains.

speaker: ystran
text: Ystran echo: ...she is tired, Linker. But she waited for you. She always knew someone would come.

speaker: Seeker
text: I've walked every fragment of this world. This is the only place that feels like it is still alive.

speaker: Arena Master
text: Welcome to the Star Arena!

speaker: Vendor
text: Pods and gels for the brave!

speaker: Arena medic
text: Arena medic: Step up to the stall and I'll patch your team up.

speaker: Fan
text: I've watched every Singularity League final. Grand Champion Nyx Horizon has never lost here!

speaker: Kid
text: I'm entering the Stardust League with my Lv 12 team! Level caps make it fair for everyone.

speaker: Commentator
text: Stardust, Comet, Supernova, Singularity. Each league has its own level cap and its own Champion.

speaker: wanderer
text: Old fan: Your team is healed before every round. Losing just ends your run, no harm done.

speaker: technician
text: Scoreboard tech: The board remembers every Linker who clears a Cup.

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: I made a cactus-berry pie for your mom. It's... a little burned. A lot burned.

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: It's weird having a normal day. Good weird.

speaker: Moving box
text: The house is empty. A sign on the door says: Reserved for the Reyes family.

speaker: Teo Reyes
text: I never saw a living Seedmother. Just the empty crater where she stood, and the Heartroot, a little dimmer every year.

speaker: Teo Reyes
text: Lumivex grew up near its light. It keeps watch on the roof now. It doesn't trust doors yet. Neither do I.

speaker: Fisher
text: Mind the nets! I just mended them.

speaker: Fisher
text: On calm nights you can hear Gloopa singing under the piers.

speaker: Rift Scout
text: Don't touch the crystals. They hum back at you.

speaker: Rift Scout
text: Every night the Rift glows a little brighter. I write it all down.

speaker: Bog Keeper
text: Welcome, welcome! Shoes off, the moss is drying.

speaker: Bog Keeper
text: The mushroom lamps glow brighter when a happy Alienmon is near.

speaker: Miner
text: Long shift in the Deep Mines. Come in, it's cooler in here.

speaker: Miner
text: If your helmet lamp flickers, turn back. That's the rule.

speaker: Sky Weaver
text: The clouds drift right past my window. I never get tired of it.

speaker: Sky Weaver
text: Play the harp if you like. The wind shrines answer it, they say.

speaker: Night DJ
text: Oh, a visitor! Welcome to my studio. Well, my living room.

speaker: Night DJ
text: DJ Static lives three towers over. I've heard every set.

speaker: Dig Assistant
text: Careful with the scrolls, they're older than the city.

speaker: Dig Assistant
text: Those glyphs on the wall? Even Dr. Vashti hasn't read them all.

speaker: Grandma Frost
text: Come warm up by the fire, dear.

speaker: Grandma Frost
text: Ingrid used to sit right there when she was little.

speaker: Captain
text: Welcome aboard! She's docked for repairs, but the view's still free.

speaker: Captain
text: On a clear day you can see every island in the Halo chain from the helm.

speaker: Prize Clerk
text: Welcome to the Neonis Arcade! The machines are being rewired for the big tournament.

speaker: Prize Clerk
text: Come back later and you might win one of those plush Alienmon on the shelf.

speaker: Field Scientist
text: Ystra was green once. Every sample we take says so.

speaker: Field Scientist
text: The crater readings change whenever a Linker walks by. Strange, isn't it?

speaker: Dock Attendant
text: Welcome to the Cloud Dock. Airships leave when the winds allow.

speaker: Dock Attendant
text: Mind the windows, the sky islands drift closer than they look.

speaker: Dig Chief
text: Every glyph on that board came out of the ground this week.

speaker: Dig Chief
text: Whoever built these ruins knew the stars far better than we do.

speaker: Greeter
text: Welcome to Sporeholm! Please don't step on the glowing moss. It bruises.

speaker: Greeter
text: The bog is safest on the lit paths. The mushroom lamps show the way.

speaker: Mushroom Keeper
text: Oh! A guest inside my mushroom. Mind the jars, they're full of spores.

speaker: Mushroom Keeper
text: This mushroom was growing before my grandmother was born. It's still growing now.

speaker: Lamplighter
text: Come in, come in. On Umbra we keep every lamp lit, all night long.

speaker: Lamplighter
text: The Devourer follows the light, they say. So we never let it go out.

speaker: Canyon Guide
text: Shoes off, the rug's my grandma's. Oven's always warm if you're hungry.

speaker: Canyon Guide
text: When the drift grass crackles at night, the Starfall Crater is glowing.

speaker: Scrap Welder
text: Every bolt in this cabin came off a crashed freighter. Hank says it's the sturdiest house on Ferrox.

speaker: Scrap Welder
text: Mind the stove. It runs on old reactor cores.

speaker: Crystal Keeper
text: These crystals grew from the old world-tree's sap. They still hum when an Alienmon walks by.

speaker: Crystal Keeper
text: Ystra was green once. Listen closely and you can hear it remembering.

speaker: Moss Tender
text: The lamps are glowcaps. Pick one and it sulks for a week.

speaker: Moss Tender
text: Sit, sit. The tea is mostly spores, but the good kind.

speaker: Old Netmender
text: You can see the whole bay from that window. Captain Marsh's boat comes in at dawn.

speaker: Old Netmender
text: If you hear singing under the pier, that's just the Gloopa. Probably.

speaker: Late-Night Coder
text: Every screen in this place is tuned to DJ Static's channel. Rent includes the bass.

speaker: Late-Night Coder
text: The crystal on the table charges my phone. Don't tell the landlord.

speaker: Ice Fisher
text: Fire's always lit. The blue flame burns colder than you'd think, but it keeps the frost off.

speaker: Ice Fisher
text: Ingrid digs fossils all winter. I just dig holes and wait for fish.

speaker: Ace Linker
text: Only the toughest teams get a seat in the Grand Stadium. Heal up before you walk in.

speaker: Ace Linker
text: The lobby's right through those big doors.

speaker: Fan
text: I came all the way up from Tarn Fork just to hear the crowd roar!

speaker: Summit Guard
text: Thin air up here. Your Alienmon tire faster than you think. Stock up first.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Summit Grand Stadium! The arena floor is straight ahead.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Every match here is a big one. Make sure your team is ready.

speaker: Fan
text: I've got my foam finger and my lucky scarf. Go get 'em, Linker!

speaker: Hiker
text: Icefall Cave is just past this ledge. Bring something warm for your team.

speaker: Hiker
text: Watch your step on the frozen floor. Sliding is fun until it isn't!

speaker: Astronomer
text: I come back down from Observatory Terrace when the clouds roll in.

speaker: Climber
text: The ice walls in here echo. Crystal-types love that sound.

speaker: Climber
text: The way down to B1 is past the frozen pillars.

speaker: Ice Cutter
text: It gets colder the deeper you go. The Deep Chamber is just ahead.

speaker: Ice Cutter
text: I've chipped ice down here for years. Still finding new tunnels!

speaker: Explorer
text: You made it to the Deep Chamber! Even the echoes freeze down here.

speaker: Explorer
text: Check every corner. Climbers leave supplies behind.

speaker: Astronomer
text: Best view of the stars on the whole mountain. On clear nights you can see other worlds.

speaker: Astronomer
text: Tarn Fork is back down the trail when you're done gazing.

speaker: Stargazer
text: I brought a blanket and a thermos. The sky does the rest.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Shh! Not many Linkers find this grove. The Relay Tower guards it like a secret.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Rare Alienmon nap under these pines.

speaker: Hermit
text: I've lived up here so long the birds bring me gossip.

speaker: Ace Linker
text: The Linker Lounge is where we rest between big battles. Grab a seat!

speaker: Ace Linker
text: Swap tips, not just Alienmon. Everyone up here has a story.

speaker: Retired Linker
text: Back in my day we climbed the whole mountain without a single Recovery Bay. Uphill both ways!

speaker: Astronomer
text: This telescope can spot a comet before it even sparkles.

speaker: Astronomer
text: Peek through if you like. Just don't sneeze on the lens!

speaker: Archivist
text: The Quorum keeps records of every great Linker battle here.

speaker: Archivist
text: Shelves on the left are old. Shelves on the right are older.

speaker: Scholar
text: I've been reading the same page for an hour. The words are tiny!

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Summit Recovery Bay. Mountain battles are tough, so let us patch up your team.

speaker: Nurse
text: Your Alienmon are fully rested. Good luck up there!

speaker: Visitor
text: My team was so cold they came in shivering. Now they're snug as can be.

speaker: Summit Guard
text: The Apex Relay Tower. Its Keeper only meets Linkers who climbed every step.

speaker: Summit Guard
text: Head inside to the trial floor when you're ready.

speaker: Ace Linker
text: I heard there's a quiet grove hidden behind the tower. Never found it myself.

speaker: Fan
text: The tower lights glow brighter when a big battle starts!

speaker: Tower Aide
text: Welcome to the trial floor! Keep your head high and your team healthy.

speaker: Tower Aide
text: The Summit Room is just beyond. You've got this!

speaker: Tower Aide
text: You reached the Summit Room! The whole mountain feels proud of you.

speaker: Resident
text: Summit Lane is the coziest street on the mountain. The Recovery Bay is right next door.

speaker: Resident
text: The supply shop sells warm gear for the climb.

speaker: Kid
text: The spaceport is down the lane! I wave at every ship that takes off.

speaker: Mail Carrier
text: Delivering letters up here means a lot of stairs. My legs are like Alloy-types now!

speaker: Old Resident
text: Stargazer Quiet Court is peaceful. Just us and the wind.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Glacier Bend is down the path if you're heading out.

speaker: Painter
text: I paint the sunrise every morning. It never looks the same twice.

speaker: Farmer
text: Mountain potatoes grow slow but taste amazing. Patience is the secret!

speaker: Farmer
text: Bio-types help pull the weeds. Good helpers, mostly.

speaker: Shepherd Kid
text: My fluffy flock loves the cold. They sleep in a big woolly pile!

speaker: Clerk
text: Welcome to the Summit Supply Shop! Potions, Cure Spray, and warm gear for the climb.

speaker: Clerk
text: Prices are a little higher up here. Hauling stock up the mountain is hard work!

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Apex Spaceport is the highest landing pad around. Pilots say it's a tricky approach.

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Summit Lane Homes is just past the gate.

speaker: Traveller
text: I flew in just to see the Grand Stadium. Is it as big as they say?

speaker: Fan
text: The Canyon Coliseum is the loudest place in Dustara. You can hear it from the Oasis!

speaker: Fan
text: The lobby's right inside the gate.

speaker: Canyon Scout
text: Coliseum champs train out on the canyon trails. Sun-baked and battle-ready.

speaker: Snack Trader
text: Cactus chips! Get your cactus chips! Perfect for cheering.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Canyon Coliseum! The arena is straight through those doors.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Heal up before you step in. The crowd loves a good long match!

speaker: Fan
text: I've seen every match this season. Okay, most of them. Okay, three.

speaker: Prospector
text: Red Rock Caves are just ahead. Bring a light, partner.

speaker: Prospector
text: The rocks glow red when the sun hits 'em. Pretty as a sunset.

speaker: Hiker
text: I'm turning back to Mesa Junction. Those caves are too twisty for me!

speaker: Miner
text: Red Rock B1. Magma-types like the warm walls in here.

speaker: Miner
text: Keep going down if you're brave. B2's even toastier.

speaker: Spelunker
text: You're in B2. The Depths are just below. I can hear something rumbling!

speaker: Spelunker
text: Don't forget to check the stash crates along the walls.

speaker: Rock Hound
text: Welcome to the Depths! I found three shiny rocks today. Well, two shiny, one kinda dull.

speaker: Oasis Hermit
text: You found the Hidden Mesa Grove! Not many folks wander off the Oasis Shore this far.

speaker: Oasis Hermit
text: Rare Bio-types nap in the palm shade.

speaker: Drifter
text: I came here for the quiet. And the coconuts.

speaker: Tea Master
text: Welcome to the Cactus Tea House. Our prickly pear tea is famous!

speaker: Tea Master
text: Sip slowly. It's spicier than it looks.

speaker: Regular
text: I come here every afternoon to dodge the desert heat.

speaker: Rock Collector
text: Welcome to my Den! Every rock here has a name. That one's Gerald.

speaker: Rock Collector
text: Bring me a rock from the canyons sometime. I love surprises.

speaker: Rune Carver
text: The Rune Workshop carves glyphs into canyon stone. Each one is a little story.

speaker: Rune Carver
text: Mind the dust. It gets everywhere!

speaker: Apprentice
text: I've carved forty runes today. Thirty-nine are crooked.

speaker: Resident
text: Dustmere Lane is quiet in the day and busy at sundown. Everyone hides from the heat!

speaker: Resident
text: The farmstead is just down the road.

speaker: Kid
text: I saw a Volt-type spark in the drift grass! Bet you can't catch it!

speaker: Old Resident
text: Dustmere Quiet Court is for folks who like a good nap.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Oasis Fork is just over yonder if you need water.

speaker: Gardener
text: Cactus gardens are easy. Just don't hug them.

speaker: Farmer
text: We grow desert melons out here. Sweet as honey and twice as sticky!

speaker: Farmer
text: The plaza's up the road if you need supplies.

speaker: Farm Kid
text: My chore is chasing Swarm-types out of the melon patch. They always come back!

speaker: Fan
text: The Scrapyard Dome is built from old train cars. Loudest arena in Rustvale!

speaker: Fan
text: The lobby's right through the iron gate.

speaker: Scrapper
text: Every bolt in that dome came from the junk heaps. Even the seats!

speaker: Snack Trader
text: Grilled corn on a stick! Great for battle watching!

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Scrapyard Dome! The arena is through those doors.

speaker: Receptionist
text: No climbing on the scrap walls, please. It's for decoration!

speaker: Fan
text: I've got a sign that says CRUSH IT. Get it? Because Alloy-types?

speaker: Miner
text: Deepcut Mine is right below. Grab a helmet if you've got one.

speaker: Miner
text: Crane Overlook is back up the hill.

speaker: Rail Hand
text: The old cart rails go all the way down. Don't ride them. Trust me.

speaker: Miner
text: B1's got the loose rocks. Alloy-types chew on 'em like snacks.

speaker: Miner
text: Stairs to B2 are deeper in.

speaker: Tunnel Digger
text: B2 is hot and dusty. The Depths are just below.

speaker: Tunnel Digger
text: Keep a Potion handy. Things down there hit hard.

speaker: Spelunker
text: You made it to the Depths! The ore down here sparkles like stars.

speaker: Scavenger
text: The Scrap Route is all junk piles and loose rails. Alienmon love hiding in the scrap.

speaker: Hauler
text: My cart threw a wheel. Again. Third time this week.

speaker: technician
text: Crane operator: Three junkers keep jamming my cranes. Hank wants them taught a lesson.

speaker: guard
text: Yard guard: No Helix allowed in this yard. Not after what they pulled last month.

speaker: Hiker
text: Tall rust-grass is where the wild ones hide. Walk around it if your team is tired.

speaker: Drifter
text: The crane yard's next. Watch for falling crates.

speaker: Scrapper
text: The Back Lot is where the junk goes to sleep. Some of it snores.

speaker: Scrapper
text: Funny, that door over there used to be locked.

speaker: Mechanic
text: Railyard Junction is back the way you came. Watch for trains!

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: What? This lab is perfectly ordinary. Stop looking at the beakers.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: Fine, fine. Touch nothing and we'll get along.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Scrap Hollow Grove. Trees growing right through old gears. Isn't it wonderful?

speaker: Wanderer
text: Swarm-types build nests in the hollow pipes.

speaker: Picnicker
text: Crane Overlook is too windy for lunch. This spot is perfect!

speaker: Salvage Trader
text: Welcome to the Salvage Shop! One Linker's junk is another Linker's treasure.

speaker: Salvage Trader
text: We don't sell this stuff. We just admire it. Mostly.

speaker: Mechanic
text: The Engine Garage fixes anything with wheels, gears, or a stubborn attitude.

speaker: Mechanic
text: Volt-types are great at jump-starting engines!

speaker: Apprentice
text: I'm only allowed to hand over wrenches. Someday I'll fix a whole engine!

speaker: Crane Operator
text: This is my bunk. Small, but I can see the whole yard from my window.

speaker: Crane Operator
text: Swinging a crane all day makes for great naps.

speaker: miner
text: Furnace worker: The heat up here peels paint off ships. Keep your Alienmon hydrated.

speaker: Guard
text: Ferrox Tower is just ahead. Hank Briggs is the Keeper. Good luck, kid.

speaker: Resident
text: Rustvale Lane Homes are built from old boilers. Warm in winter, toasty in summer!

speaker: Resident
text: The spaceport's just past the last house.

speaker: Kid
text: I'm building a robot out of spare parts. It doesn't move yet. Or ever.

speaker: Neighbour
text: Rustvale's just down the road if you need the Recovery Bay.

speaker: technician
text: Junk dealer: One Linker's trash is another Linker's treasure. Mostly it's just trash.

speaker: Shopper
text: I came for a bolt and left with a jetpack. It doesn't work, but still.

speaker: miner
text: Ore trader: Ferrox ore powers half the ships in the system. Helix wants all of it.

speaker: wanderer
text: Fortune teller: I see... a tower. And a man with a very large wrench.

speaker: Farmer
text: Turnips grow tough in Ferrox soil. Tough enough to dent a wrench!

speaker: Farmer
text: The Scrapyard Dome is right next door. Noisy neighbors!

speaker: Farm Kid
text: Our goats eat tin cans. Mom says that's normal here.

speaker: Fan
text: Glacier Rink Arena! Battles on ice are slippery and super exciting.

speaker: Fan
text: The lobby's right inside, and it's heated!

speaker: Skater
text: I skate here before the battles. The ice is perfect today.

speaker: Researcher
text: The Research Annex is next door. Lots of buzzing machines over there.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Glacier Rink Arena! The Battle Room is just past this lobby.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Watch your footing in there. The floor is real ice!

speaker: Fan
text: I wore three scarves today. Arena seats get chilly!

speaker: Climber
text: The Crystal Caverns are right through that ice arch.

speaker: Climber
text: Crystal-types glitter in there. Bring something with punch.

speaker: Radio Tech
text: I'm checking the cave signal relay. Ice Junction is back the way you came.

speaker: technician
text: Radio tech: The Crystal Caverns are ahead. Three floors deep, then up into the Fossil Dig.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Fire melts ice, they say. Bring something hot for Ingrid's team.

speaker: Explorer
text: Crevasse Hollows! Mind the cracks. Jump them, don't walk them.

speaker: Explorer
text: There's supplies hidden in the hollows if you look.

speaker: Climber
text: Frostmark Quiet Court is back up the slope if you need a breather.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The falls froze the night the aurora turned violet. I come here to listen.

speaker: Climber
text: Aurora Tower is just east. Ingrid trains Cryo-types up top.

speaker: researcher
text: Dig chief: Three fossil sites, same bite pattern every time. Read the markers.

speaker: Digger
text: I asked Helix for better drills. They asked where the biggest bones were.

speaker: miner
text: I didn't tell them.

speaker: Researcher
text: The Frozen Research Annex studies ice and the critters living in it.

speaker: Researcher
text: The arena next door gets loud. Hard to concentrate!

speaker: Radio Tech
text: Some odd signals come from the lab out back. Probably nothing. Probably.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: Ugh, visitors. This lab is cold enough without the door opening.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: Look around if you must. Just don't unplug anything.

speaker: Wanderer
text: The Hidden Ice Grove! Frozen trees that sparkle like crystal.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Rare Alienmon nap under the snow here.

speaker: Snow Painter
text: I paint the frost on the branches. It melts before I finish!

speaker: Researcher
text: This Research Lab tracks every snowflake in Glacia. Every. Single. One.

speaker: Researcher
text: Fun fact: Crystal-types grow faster in the cold!

speaker: Lab Assistant
text: I've labelled two hundred ice samples today. My fingers are numb!

speaker: Lodge Keeper
text: Welcome to the Hot Cocoa Lodge! Warm up by the fire.

speaker: Lodge Keeper
text: Extra marshmallows on the house today.

speaker: Traveller
text: I came in for one cup. That was four cups ago.

speaker: Curator
text: The Fossil Vault holds ancient Alienmon bones from the glacier.

speaker: Curator
text: Please don't touch the big one. It's very old and very grumpy-looking.

speaker: Visitor
text: I counted the teeth on that skull. I lost count at forty.

speaker: Tower Fan
text: The Aurora Relay Tower glows green and gold at night. So pretty!

speaker: Tower Fan
text: The trial floor is just inside the doors. Bundle up!

speaker: Tower Guard
text: Keep your team warm before you climb. The Keeper's battles are chilly.

speaker: Resident
text: Frostmark Lane Homes have extra-thick walls. Keeps the blizzards out!

speaker: Resident
text: The spaceport is down at the end of the lane.

speaker: Kid
text: I built a snow Alienmon! Wanna see? It's the lumpy one.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Frostmark Quiet Court is calm. Snow muffles all the noise.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Crevasse Hollows is down the slope. Watch for cracks!

speaker: Knitter
text: I knit sweaters for Alienmon. They love the ones with pom-poms.

speaker: Farmer
text: Ice berries grow under the snow. Dig gently and you'll find them!

speaker: Farmer
text: The arena's right next door if you want to watch a battle.

speaker: Farm Kid
text: My woolly pets are the warmest things in Glacia. Hug one!

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Glacia Spaceport. Ships need extra de-icing before takeoff.

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Frostmark Lane Homes is just past the gate.

speaker: Traveller
text: I packed shorts. That was a mistake.

speaker: Fan
text: The Temple of Trials! Battles here have been held for ages and ages.

speaker: Fan
text: The lobby is through the big stone doors.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The glyphs on the pillars cheer for every Linker who enters.

speaker: Archaeologist
text: Glyph Hollow is just around the corner. Worth a look!

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Temple of Trials! The arena awaits beyond these halls.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Battles here are graded by the old glyphs. No pressure!

speaker: Fan
text: My grandma watched battles here. So did her grandma!

speaker: Archaeologist
text: The Drowned Grotto is below. Half the ruins down there are underwater!

speaker: Archaeologist
text: Hydro-types are everywhere. Bring a Volt-type if you can.

speaker: Rune Scholar
text: Glyph Steps is back up the stairs. Mind the moss!

speaker: Diver
text: B1's pools are deeper than they look. Stick to the dry stones.

speaker: Diver
text: The way down to B2 is past the flooded hall.

speaker: Explorer
text: You're in B2. The Deep Chamber is just ahead. Spooky but beautiful!

speaker: Explorer
text: The glyphs here glow faintly in the water.

speaker: Treasure Hunter
text: The Deep Chamber at last! I came for treasure and stayed for the view.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Tall grass grows thick between the ruins. Wild Alienmon hide in every patch.

speaker: researcher
text: Rune scholar: The glyph under that pool glows at night. I think the whole valley was once a temple.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: Weaken a wild one before you throw a Stasis Pod. A tired Alienmon is an easy catch.

speaker: Archaeologist
text: Tidepool Ruins! The tide covers these pillars twice a day.

speaker: Archaeologist
text: Check the pools for supplies the waves wash in.

speaker: Beachcomber
text: I found a shell with a glyph on it! Or maybe it's just a scratch.

speaker: Boater
text: The Sunken Channel was a road once. Now it's a river!

speaker: Boater
text: Forgotten Forum is just back the way you came.

speaker: Swimmer
text: Hydro-types zip through the channel. Fast little things!

speaker: Wanderer
text: Coral Secret Grove! Coral growing on land. Glyphos is full of surprises.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Rare Alienmon love the shady reef trees.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: I came here to meditate. A crab pinched my toe. Very calming.

speaker: Archivist
text: The Archivist's Study holds rubbings of every glyph in Glyphos.

speaker: Archivist
text: Some glyphs tell jokes. Very old jokes.

speaker: Student
text: I'm learning to read glyphs. So far I know 'sun' and 'snack'.

speaker: Dig Leader
text: Welcome to the Dig Camp Tent! Maps, brushes, and a lot of sand.

speaker: Dig Leader
text: We dig carefully. Every pebble could be history.

speaker: Digger
text: I found a pot handle today! Just the handle. Still exciting!

speaker: Shrine Keeper
text: The Shrine Chamber is a quiet place. Speak softly.

speaker: Shrine Keeper
text: Psi-types feel calm in here. Maybe you will too.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: I come here to think. Mostly about lunch.

speaker: Resident
text: Dig Camp Lane Homes. We live in tents and huts close to the dig.

speaker: Resident
text: The farmstead is just down the path.

speaker: Kid
text: I dug a hole so deep I found another hole!

speaker: Old Resident
text: Dig Camp Quiet Court is where retired diggers rest their backs.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Ruin Crossroads is close by if you need to head out.

speaker: Storyteller
text: Sit by the fire tonight and I'll tell you about the old glyph kings.

speaker: Farmer
text: We grow date palms and sand beans. Desert farming takes patience!

speaker: Farmer
text: The crossroads is just over the hill.

speaker: Farm Kid
text: My job is to chase Swarm-types off the date palms. They're sneaky!

speaker: Clerk
text: Welcome to the Dig Camp Supply Shop! Brushes, Potions, and Cure Spray.

speaker: Clerk
text: Sand gets in everything. Buy extra Potions just in case!

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Glyphos Spaceport! Sand storms make landing an adventure.

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Ruin Crossroads is right outside the gate.

speaker: Traveller
text: I came to see the ruins. I brought a hat and three water bottles.

speaker: Fan
text: The Sky Colosseum floats on the clouds! Best battles in the sky.

speaker: Fan
text: The lobby's right through the golden arch.

speaker: Skywatcher
text: Don't look over the edge before a match. Makes your knees wobble.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The Sky Temple is just next door. The bells ring after every match.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Sky Colosseum! The Battle Floor is just past this hall.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Fliers and Gravity-types love battling up here!

speaker: Fan
text: I cheered so loud last match, a cloud floated away.

speaker: Explorer
text: Crystal Hollow is right through there. The walls sparkle like stars!

speaker: Explorer
text: Cloud Fork is back down the path.

speaker: Mystic
text: The crystals inside hum softly. Listen closely.

speaker: Crystal Hunter
text: 1F is full of shiny walls. Crystal-types blend right in.

speaker: Crystal Hunter
text: Climb on to 2F. The crystals get even shinier!

speaker: Spelunker
text: 2F already! The Heart is just ahead. It glows so bright!

speaker: Wanderer
text: The Crystal Hollow Heart. I could sit here all day watching it shimmer.

speaker: explorer
text: Bridge walker: The ropes creak, but they've held for three hundred years. Probably.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: Wild Alienmon hide in the pink blossoms. Step around them if your team is worn out.

speaker: Skywatcher
text: See those little islands drifting by? Some of them glitter with Signal Shard dust.

speaker: Mystic
text: The wind sings louder near the temple. The twins say it is singing your name.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: Shrine Hollows! Little shrines are tucked into every cloud nook.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: Cloud Fork is back the way you came.

speaker: Bell Ringer
text: I ring the tiny bells here every morning. They sound like rain.

speaker: Botanist
text: These blossoms only grow above the clouds. Psi-types nest in them when the wind is calm.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The Sky Temple is just east. Echo and Iris accept every challenger, but few leave smiling.

speaker: Gardener
text: Hidden Blossom Grove! The petals here float upward instead of down.

speaker: Gardener
text: Rare Bio-types nap under the blossoms.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: I wandered off Cloud Fork and found this. Best wrong turn ever.

speaker: Chapel Keeper
text: The Skyfarm Chapel blesses each harvest. Even the cloud carrots!

speaker: Chapel Keeper
text: Sit a while. The wind chimes are very calming.

speaker: Librarian
text: The Oracle Library has books about all fourteen worlds.

speaker: Librarian
text: Quiet, please. The books are sleeping. Just kidding! Mostly.

speaker: Scholar
text: I'm reading about Psi-types. They can predict which page I'll turn to next!

speaker: Gardener
text: The Cloud Garden Room grows plants in pure mist. No soil at all!

speaker: Gardener
text: Water them? No, they water themselves.

speaker: Visitor
text: I touched a cloud flower. It felt like a sneeze.

speaker: Temple Guard
text: The Sky Temple. Its trial floor tests Linkers with heart and patience.

speaker: Temple Guard
text: Head inside when your team is ready.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The temple bells ring after every match at the Colosseum next door.

speaker: Skywatcher
text: Temple Junction is just down the steps if you need a breather.

speaker: Resident
text: Skyreach Lane Homes float on their own little islands. Bridges connect them all.

speaker: Resident
text: Halo Spaceport is a short hop down the lane.

speaker: Kid
text: I jumped from one island to the other! Don't tell my mom!

speaker: Old Resident
text: Skyreach Quiet Court is peaceful. Just clouds and birdsong.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Sky Crossroads is right next door.

speaker: Cloud Watcher
text: That cloud looks like an Alienmon! Oh, now it looks like a sandwich.

speaker: Farmer
text: Skyfarm Edge grows cloud carrots and sky melons. Very light and fluffy!

speaker: Farmer
text: Windstep Rise is up the path.

speaker: Farm Kid
text: My fluffy flock floats a little when it's windy. I tie them to the fence!

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Halo Spaceport. We dock ships right on the clouds! Safer than it sounds.

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Skyreach Lane Homes is just past the gate.

speaker: Traveller
text: First time up here? Don't look down. Okay, maybe once.

speaker: Visitor
text: The Helix Proving Grounds used to be off-limits. Now anyone can come watch!

speaker: Visitor
text: The lobby's right through the blast doors.

speaker: Engineer
text: We repainted everything. It's way less scary in yellow.

speaker: Tour Guide
text: The Comms Spire is just next door. Tours every hour!

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Proving Grounds! The Battle Room is straight ahead.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Please keep your hands inside the station at all times.

speaker: Fan
text: I never thought I'd cheer on a space station. This is great!

speaker: Miner
text: Rift Rock Mine is just below. The rocks hum a little. Don't worry about it.

speaker: Miner
text: Hangar Deck is back up the ramp.

speaker: Technician
text: I'm fixing the mine lights. Half of them blink. The other half wink.

speaker: Explorer
text: 1F of the Rift Rock Mine. The rocks float a bit. Gravity-types love it here!

speaker: Explorer
text: Head deeper in to find the way up to 2F.

speaker: Rock Sampler
text: 2F. The Deep Chamber is just ahead. Grab your samples and go!

speaker: Old Miner
text: The Deep Chamber! Even the dust sparkles down here.

speaker: Stargazer
text: Viewport Overlook! You can see whole planets drift by out there.

speaker: Stargazer
text: The Specimen Annex is back that way.

speaker: Visitor
text: I pressed my face to the glass. It's still cold.

speaker: Gardener
text: The Hidden Hydro Garden! Plants grow in water pipes up here.

speaker: Gardener
text: Hydro-types and Bio-types get along great in this garden.

speaker: Botanist
text: Hydroponics Edge is just back the way you came.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: This is the Containment Lab. Everything is contained. Very contained. Please go.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: Don't tap on the tanks! They hate that. I hate that.

speaker: Crewmate
text: The Crew Quarters. Bunks, snacks, and a lot of snoring.

speaker: Crewmate
text: Space naps are the best naps.

speaker: Cook
text: I make space soup. It's soup. In space.

speaker: Bridge Officer
text: This is the Command Bridge. Don't touch the big red button. Or the small red one.

speaker: Bridge Officer
text: We steer the whole station from here!

speaker: Navigator
text: I plot our course. Today's course: stay right here.

speaker: Visitor
text: The Helix Comms Spire! It used to send secret messages. Now it plays music!

speaker: Visitor
text: The trial floor is just inside. Mind the blinking floor panels!

speaker: Guard
text: Linkers only past this point. The Keeper is waiting upstairs.

speaker: Tower Aide
text: Welcome to the trial floor! Keep calm and battle on.

speaker: Tower Aide
text: The Uplink Room is just beyond. You're doing great!

speaker: Tower Aide
text: You made it to the Uplink Room! Signals from all over the stars come in here.

speaker: Resident
text: Habitation Row. Little rooms, big windows, and the best view of the stars.

speaker: Resident
text: The Docking Ring is just down the corridor.

speaker: Kid
text: I learned to float in zero gravity! Well, for two seconds.

speaker: Retired Officer
text: Officers Court used to be strict. Now it's mostly naps and card games.

speaker: Retired Officer
text: Station Coolant Fork is just down the hall.

speaker: Neighbour
text: Shh! The officer next door is trying to sleep.

speaker: Gardener
text: Hydroponics Edge grows all the station's food. Even the space carrots!

speaker: Gardener
text: There's a hidden garden past the pipes. Shhh!

speaker: Botanist
text: Bio-types love the bright grow lamps up here.

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Helix Station Spaceport! The docking clamps are a little loud. Sorry!

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Deck Crossroads is just past the gate.

speaker: Traveller
text: First time on a space station? It's like a giant tin can!

speaker: Fan
text: Neon Megadome! The lights flash with every hit. So cool!

speaker: Fan
text: The lobby's right through the glowing doors.

speaker: Raver
text: I came for the battles. I stayed for the light show.

speaker: Snack Trader
text: Glow pops! Get your glow pops! They sparkle in your mouth!

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Neon Megadome! The Battle Floor is just ahead.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Sunglasses are recommended. The lights are very bright!

speaker: Fan
text: I painted my face with glowing paint. My mom will be thrilled.

speaker: Courier
text: The Undercity Tunnels are down there. Dark and full of old wires!

speaker: Courier
text: Skyline Overlook is back up the stairs.

speaker: Coder
text: I'm fixing the tunnel signs. They keep saying 'ERROR' instead of 'EXIT'.

speaker: Explorer
text: B1 of the Undercity. Volt-types chew on the old cables down here.

speaker: Explorer
text: The stairs to B2 are past the old train car.

speaker: Repair Tech
text: B2 already! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. Spooky hum down there.

speaker: Tunnel Rat
text: The Deep Chamber! I live down here. Rent's cheap.

speaker: technician
text: Dish tech: These antennas relay DJ Static's show to the whole system. Someone keeps hijacking channel 9.

speaker: Hiker
text: The glowing grass is full of wild Alienmon. Keep a few Stasis Pods handy.

speaker: researcher
text: Radio fan: DJ Static picked up a signal coming from the Starfall Rift. It repeats every 8 seconds.

speaker: Raver
text: Voltspire is just east. Static's apprentices guard the first floor. They're loud. Really loud.

speaker: Boater
text: The Static Canal fizzes with Volt energy. Don't dip your toes in!

speaker: Boater
text: Arcade Alleys is just back the way you came.

speaker: Fisher
text: I fish here every night. I mostly catch glowing boots.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Helix Front Office. Please take a number.

speaker: Receptionist
