text: The lab in the back is for staff only. Supposedly.

speaker: Visitor
text: I came here to complain about the noise. Nobody's listening.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: Oh no, a visitor. Please don't touch the screens. They're very sensitive.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: I'm just running a test. Nothing to see. Okay, a little to see.

speaker: Gardener
text: Glowgarden Hideaway! Plants that glow like neon signs!

speaker: Gardener
text: Rare Alienmon nap under the bright leaves.

speaker: Visitor
text: I found this place off Canal Fork. Shhh, keep it a secret!

speaker: Producer
text: The Recording Studio! We record Sonic-type songs here.

speaker: Producer
text: Listen to that beat! Sonic-types are total naturals.

speaker: Singer
text: I'm practicing my high notes. LA LA LAAAA! How was that?

speaker: Noodle Chef
text: Welcome to the Noodle Bar! Spicy, sweet, or extra glowing?

speaker: Noodle Chef
text: Slurping is allowed. Encouraged, even!

speaker: Regular
text: I come here every night after work. The noodles never disappoint.

speaker: Fan
text: Voltspire Plaza! The Relay Tower crackles with lightning.

speaker: Fan
text: Step through the doors to the trial floor. Sparks fly in there!

speaker: Tower Guard
text: Volt-types rule this tower. Bring a Gravity-type or something that grounds them!

speaker: Raver
text: The plaza lights pulse to the beat of the tower. Dance with me!

speaker: Resident
text: Neonis Lane Homes. Little apartments with big glowing signs.

speaker: Resident
text: Neon Boulevard is just down the street.

speaker: Kid
text: My window faces a giant sign. It's always daytime in my room!

speaker: Old Resident
text: Neonis Quiet Court is the only dark spot in the city. Lovely, isn't it?

speaker: Old Resident
text: Neon Crossroads is close by.

speaker: Cat Owner
text: My cat stares at the neon all night. I think it likes the colours.

speaker: Farmer
text: Neonis Farmstead Edge grows glowing lettuce under the city lights!

speaker: Farmer
text: The Megadome is right next door. Very noisy at night!

speaker: Farm Kid
text: I feed the glow sheep every morning. They sparkle when they're happy!

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Neonis Spaceport! Ships land right on the neon pads.

speaker: Dock Tech
text: The Starport is just through the gate.

speaker: Traveller
text: I came for the arcades. I'm leaving with zero Stardust and a giant plush toy.

speaker: Fan
text: Magma Pit Arena! Battles here are scorching hot.

speaker: Fan
text: The lobby's right through the fire doors.

speaker: Miner
text: I watch every match after my shift. Hot battles warm the heart!

speaker: Snack Trader
text: Lava-roasted nuts! Crunchy, toasty, and only a little bit smoky!

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Magma Pit Arena! The Battle Room is just past the lobby.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Bring something Hydro if you want to stay cool in there.

speaker: Fan
text: I wore my fireproof shoes. You never know!

speaker: Miner
text: The Deep Mines are just below. Hot, dark, and full of Magma-types.

speaker: Miner
text: Mine Shaft Hollows is back the way you came.

speaker: Ash Walker
text: Bring a Hydro-type and lots of water. It's like an oven down there!

speaker: technician
text: Forge keeper: Every forge on this ridge was lit from the volcano's heart. Old Basalt lit half of 'em.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The Volcano Tower is just east. Keeper Basalt waits at the top. He doesn't go easy on anyone.

speaker: strand
text: Helix grunt: Nothing to see here. Just... surveying the ridge. Move along, Linker.

speaker: miner
text: Rail hand: Stay off the tracks when a cart's coming. The carts don't stop, and neither does the lava.

speaker: wanderer
text: Ash walker: Wild Alienmon nest in the ember-weed. Stick to the dirt if you want a quiet walk.

speaker: technician
text: Rail smith: The Deep Mines start past the east bend. Three levels down, and hotter every level.

speaker: Hiker
text: Trainers out here spot you from five paces. Eyes front, Pods ready.

speaker: Old Smith
text: The Abandoned Smelter hasn't melted a thing in years.

speaker: Old Smith
text: Funny, I heard machines running in the back last night.

speaker: Ash Walker
text: Mine Junction is just down the road if you need to head back.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: You! This lab is way too hot already. Don't make it hotter.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: Look, I just watch the gauges. Please stop staring at the gauges.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Ember Hollow Grove! Trees with leaves like glowing embers.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Rare Magma-types nap in the warm ashes here.

speaker: Picnicker
text: Cinder Hollow Quiet Court is just back that way. Bring marshmallows next time!

speaker: Canteen Cook
text: Welcome to the Miners' Canteen! Hot soup for hard workers.

speaker: Canteen Cook
text: Try the lava stew! It's actually just very spicy beans.

speaker: Miner
text: I eat here every day. The cook remembers everybody's order.

speaker: Smith
text: The Smelter Room melts ore into shiny metal. Stand back from the glow!

speaker: Smith
text: Magma-types help keep the fires roaring.

speaker: Apprentice
text: I'm learning to pour molten metal. Very slowly. Very carefully.

speaker: Caretaker
text: These are the old miner's quarters. Tidy, warm, and full of rock samples.

speaker: Caretaker
text: Please don't move anything. Every pebble has its spot.

speaker: Fan
text: The Volcano Relay Tower! You can feel the heat from here.

speaker: Fan
text: Head through the doors to the trial floor. It gets hotter every step!

speaker: Tower Guard
text: Bring your toughest team. The Keeper up there doesn't cool off.

speaker: Resident
text: Cinder Hollow Lane Homes have stone walls. The volcano keeps them cozy!

speaker: Resident
text: Pyros Spaceport is just down the lane. Watch for hot exhaust!

speaker: Kid
text: I can cook an egg on the sidewalk! Mom says not to try.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Cinder Hollow Quiet Court. Calm, warm, and just a little ashy.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Ember Hollow Grove is down the path. Lovely glowing trees!

speaker: Neighbour
text: I sweep ash off my porch every morning. It's my exercise.

speaker: Farmer
text: We grow fire peppers out here. They're spicy enough to make a Magma-type cry!

speaker: Farmer
text: The arena's next door. Battle cheers at all hours!

speaker: Farm Kid
text: I water the pepper plants. The water steams right off!

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Pyros Spaceport! Ships need heat shields to land here.

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Cinder Hollow Lane Homes is just past the gate.

speaker: Traveller
text: I packed a winter coat. Big mistake.

speaker: Fan
text: Mycelium Bowl! The arena is made of a giant mushroom cap!

speaker: Fan
text: The lobby's right inside the stem doors.

speaker: Spore Tender
text: The Relay Tower is next door. It glows extra bright on match nights.

speaker: Bog Hiker
text: Capstep Rise is just back up the path.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Mycelium Bowl! The arena is just ahead.

speaker: Receptionist
text: The floor is a little squishy. Mind your step!

speaker: Fan
text: I brought spore lanterns to wave! The glow matches my team!

speaker: Bog Hiker
text: Mushroom Maze Cave is just through there. Easy to get lost!

speaker: Bog Hiker
text: Sporecap Overlook is back up the trail.

speaker: Explorer
text: Mark your path with the glowing caps. That's how I get home!

speaker: Spore Tender
text: Mushroom Maze B1. The glow caps point the way down.

speaker: Spore Tender
text: Toxin-types hide in the stinky corners. Pack Cure Spray!

speaker: Mycologist
text: These bridges grow on their own. The mushrooms knit the planks back together each night.

speaker: Explorer
text: The Deep Chamber! The biggest mushroom I've ever seen lives down here.

speaker: Botanist
text: Every lantern in this marsh is a living fungus. Don't pick them. They bite back.

speaker: explorer
text: Bog hiker: Wild aliens jump out of the reeds. Stick to the dirt paths if your team is tired.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: Listen... the Spore Choir. The pools sing when the spores rise. Some say the tower answers.

speaker: sporefolk
text: Spore tender: The big lily pads hold your weight. Mostly. Hop across them to reach the tower path.

speaker: sporefolk
text: Spore tender: The Mushroom Maze is just ahead. Left at the glowing caps... or was it right?

speaker: Wanderer
text: Trainers watch the paths. Step into their line of sight and it's a battle.

speaker: Fisher
text: Bogwater Bend! The water is murky, but the fish are friendly.

speaker: Fisher
text: Lantern Marsh Shore is just back the way you came.

speaker: Bog Hiker
text: Hydro-types and Toxin-types share this bend. Bring a mix!

speaker: Botanist
text: Glowcap Meadow! Every mushroom here glows a different color.

speaker: Botanist
text: Bog Fork is just down the path.

speaker: Picnicker
text: I lay down here to watch the caps glow. Best show in Sporeholm!

speaker: Wanderer
text: Mirefen Secret Grove! Hidden right behind the farmstead.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Rare Bio-types nap under the giant caps here.

speaker: Spore Tender
text: Shhh! The glow moths are sleeping.

speaker: Herbalist
text: Welcome to my Herbalist Hut! Herbs for every sniffle and sneeze.

speaker: Herbalist
text: Mushroom tea cures almost anything. Except boredom.

speaker: Helper
text: I sort the herbs by smell. Some smell like socks.

speaker: Botanist
text: The Spore Lab studies how mushrooms glow. Fascinating stuff!

speaker: Botanist
text: Please don't sniff the samples. Trust me.

speaker: Lab Assistant
text: I counted spores all day. My eyes are glowing now.

speaker: Resident
text: Welcome to my Marsh Cottage! It's small, but the lily pads out back are lovely.

speaker: Resident
text: Want some swamp tea? It's better than it sounds.

speaker: Fan
text: The Sporeholm Relay Tower! The mushrooms around it glow brighter every day.

speaker: Fan
text: The trial floor is just inside, past the glowing caps.

speaker: Tower Guard
text: Bring a Plasma-type if you have one. Bio-types don't like the heat!

speaker: Resident
text: Mirefen Lane Homes are built on stilts above the bog. Dry and cozy!

speaker: Resident
text: The spaceport and the village are both close by.

speaker: Kid
text: I jumped from lily pad to lily pad all the way home! Splash!

speaker: Old Resident
text: Mirefen Quiet Court is peaceful. Just frogs and glow moths.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Sporelake Shore is just down the path.

speaker: Neighbour
text: I hum to my mushrooms. They grow better with a little music.

speaker: Farmer
text: Mirefen Farmstead grows bog rice and swamp beans. Wet work!

speaker: Farmer
text: There's a secret grove out back. Don't tell anyone I told you.

speaker: Farm Kid
text: I wade through the rice paddies every morning. My boots are always squishy!

speaker: Swimmer
text: Sporelake Shore! The lake glows blue at night.

speaker: Swimmer
text: Mirefen Quiet Court is just back up the path.

speaker: Bog Hiker
text: Hydro-types splash around the shore. Bring a Volt-type!

speaker: Fan
text: Rift Crater Arena! Battles right on the edge of the crater!

speaker: Fan
text: The lobby's right through the stone gate.

speaker: Rift Seeker
text: The crater hums louder on match nights. Can you feel it?

speaker: Snack Trader
text: Star crunch bars! Sweet, crunchy, and a little sparkly!

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Rift Crater Arena! The arena floor is just ahead.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Crystal-types love battling here. The glow helps them focus!

speaker: Fan
text: I brought a telescope to watch the battles. Is that weird?

speaker: Rift Seeker
text: Starstone Hollow is just through there. The rocks twinkle like stars!

speaker: Rift Seeker
text: Craterstep Slope is back up the trail.

speaker: Rock Hound
text: I'm collecting starstones. This one's my favorite. And this one. And this one.

speaker: Star Watcher
text: B1 of Starstone Hollow. Crystal-types grow right out of the walls.

speaker: Star Watcher
text: The way down to B2 is past the glowing pillar.

speaker: Explorer
text: B2 already! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. The glow gets stronger!

speaker: Explorer
text: The Deep Chamber! It's like standing inside a star.

speaker: Rift Seeker
text: Rift Edge! Don't lean too far. The crater goes way down.

speaker: Rift Seeker
text: Rift Fork is just back that way.

speaker: Hiker
text: Void-types sometimes peek out from the cracks. Spooky!

speaker: Seedpod Hunter
text: Seedpod Hollows! Old seedpods lie all around here.

speaker: Seedpod Hunter
text: Some still glow faintly. Pretty, right?

speaker: Star Watcher
text: Rift Fork is just back the way you came.

speaker: explorer
text: Rift seeker: Trainers out here spot you from five tiles off. Heal up before you walk their line of sight.

speaker: Driller
text: Helix paid triple to dig here. Then the pods started glowing back. Nobody stayed for the bonus.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Starfall Secret Grove! Trees that sparkle like the night sky.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Rare Alienmon nap under the starry leaves.

speaker: Stargazer
text: I found this place by following a shooting star. True story!

speaker: Greenhouse Keeper
text: The Seedpod Greenhouse grows plants from crater seeds.

speaker: Greenhouse Keeper
text: Some sprout overnight. Some take years. Patience!

speaker: Gardener
text: I watered a seedpod and it giggled. I think.

speaker: Star Watcher
text: The Observation Post watches the crater day and night.

speaker: Star Watcher
text: Look through the scope! You might spot a shooting star.

speaker: Assistant
text: I write down every twinkle. My notebook is full of dots.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: This is a field office. A perfectly normal field office. Please leave.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: Okay, fine, look around. Just don't touch the drill charts.

speaker: Resident
text: Starfall Lane Homes are right by Rim Camp. The shop's just around the corner!

speaker: Resident
text: The crater glows purple on clear nights.

speaker: Kid
text: I saw a shooting star last night! I wished for a Gravity-type.

speaker: Neighbour
text: Crater Crossroads is close by if you need to head out.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Starfall Quiet Court. Quiet, except when the crater hums.

speaker: Old Resident
text: There's a secret grove down the path. Lovely sparkly trees!

speaker: Stargazer
text: I count the stars every night. I'm up to seven thousand.

speaker: Farmer
text: Starfall Farmstead Edge grows crater corn. It glows a little when it's ripe!

speaker: Farmer
text: The arena's right next door. Loud on match nights!

speaker: Farm Kid
text: I feed the farm critters seedpod crumbs. They love it!

speaker: Clerk
text: Welcome to the Starfall Shop! Potions, Cure Spray, and supplies for the crater.

speaker: Clerk
text: Rift trails are rocky. Stock up before you head out!

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Starfall Spaceport! Ships land right near the crater rim.

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Rift Fork is just past the gate.

speaker: Traveller
text: I came to see the crater glow. It's even better in person!

speaker: Fan
text: Tidewater Arena! Battles with the sea spray in your face!

speaker: Fan
text: The lobby's right through the dock doors.

speaker: Sailor
text: The Harbor Relay Tower is just next door. You can see it from the boats!

speaker: Snack Trader
text: Fish sticks! Fresh from the harbor! Get 'em while they're hot!

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to Tidewater Arena! The Battle Room is just past the lobby.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Hydro-types make a big splash here. Literally!

speaker: Fan
text: I got soaked in the front row last time. Best seats in the house!

speaker: Beachcomber
text: The Sea Cave is just through there. The tide flows right in!

speaker: Beachcomber
text: Dune Stairway is back up the path.

speaker: Explorer
text: Bring a Volt-type. Hydro-types love those caves.

speaker: Sailor
text: B1 of the Sea Cave. Mind the puddles. Some of them bite.

speaker: Sailor
text: The way down to B2 is past the tide pools.

speaker: Diver
text: B2! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. The water glows blue down there.

speaker: Explorer
text: The Deep Chamber! I can hear the waves crashing above us.

speaker: Castaway
text: Saw an old wreck off the south rocks. Nobody's dared dive it yet.

speaker: Sailor
text: Harbor Tower is past the sea arch. Captain Marsh doesn't go easy on anyone.

speaker: researcher
text: Keeper's aide: The stairs up top lead out onto the coral sand bars. Watch for the tide.

speaker: squidsailor
text: Lamp tender: This light guided the fishing fleet for a hundred years. Helix ships ignore it.

speaker: Researcher
text: Readings spike under the arch at night. Whatever sleeps there is enormous.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: Walk softly here. The islanders leave shells at the shrines so Anchorath sleeps on.

speaker: Lookout
text: Helix divers were poking around the cove. I chased them off with a bucket.

speaker: Beachcomber
text: Driftwood Hollows! The waves wash up all sorts of treasures here.

speaker: Beachcomber
text: Tidal Inlet is just back the way you came.

speaker: Swimmer
text: I built a fort out of driftwood! Wanna see?

speaker: Beachcomber
text: The coral bars connect at low tide. Hop the bridges and you'll stay dry.

speaker: Swimmer
text: My Alienmon love the shallows. Low-level ones, sure, but they never stop splashing.

speaker: Boat Builder
text: Saltreach Boathouse. We build and fix all the boats in the harbor.

speaker: Boat Builder
text: Hmm, the back door's been open a lot lately. Strange.

speaker: Dockhand
text: Dune Junction is just up the path.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: Ugh, the boathouse door again. This lab is very damp and very private.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: Look, I just study fish. Mostly fish. Please don't touch the tanks.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Saltreach Secret Grove! Palm trees and sea breeze. Perfect!

speaker: Wanderer
text: Rare Hydro-types nap in the shady pools here.

speaker: Picnicker
text: I found this place behind the Quiet Court. Best picnic spot ever!

speaker: Harbormaster
text: Welcome to the Harbormaster's Office. I keep track of every boat in port.

speaker: Harbormaster
text: The harbor's busy today. Three ships in, two out, and one lost hat.

speaker: Sailor
text: I'm here to sign in my boat. The paperwork takes longer than the trip!

speaker: Fishmonger
text: Fresh fish! Caught this morning! Well, most of it.

speaker: Fishmonger
text: My best customers are hungry Alienmon. They pay in smiles.

speaker: Shopper
text: I just want one fish. Why are there so many kinds?

speaker: Ship's Mate
text: This is the Captain's Cabin. Maps, compasses, and lots of seashells.

speaker: Ship's Mate
text: The captain's out at sea. I'm keeping things tidy until they're back.

speaker: Fan
text: The Harbor Relay Tower! It lights the way for ships at night.

speaker: Fan
text: Climb inside to the trial floor. The sea breeze follows you up!

speaker: Tower Guard
text: Hydro-types rule this tower. Bring Volt or Bio types if you've got 'em!

speaker: Resident
text: Saltreach Lane Homes face the sea. You can hear the waves all night.

speaker: Resident
text: Saltreach Market is just down the street.

speaker: Kid
text: I found a crab in my shoe this morning. I named him Pinchy!

speaker: Neighbour
text: The boardwalk is just around the corner if you want to stroll.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Saltreach Quiet Court is peaceful. Just gulls and waves.

speaker: Old Resident
text: There's a secret grove out back. Lovely palm trees!

speaker: Fisher
text: I fish off my porch every morning. Mostly I catch seaweed.

speaker: Farmer
text: Saltreach Farmstead grows sea grapes and kelp. Salty and delicious!

speaker: Farmer
text: Lagoon Fork is just down the path.

speaker: Farm Kid
text: I feed the farm critters seaweed snacks. They love them!

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Thalassa Spaceport! Ships land right next to the boat docks.

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Port Saltreach Docks is just past the gate.

speaker: Traveller
text: I came by spaceship, but I'm leaving by boat. Adventure!

speaker: Surfer
text: Open Water Shore! The waves here are perfect for surfing.

speaker: Surfer
text: Coral Cove is just back that way.

speaker: Swimmer
text: Hydro-types surf the waves right alongside me!

speaker: Fan
text: The Lantern Pit! Battles lit only by lanterns. So spooky and cool!

speaker: Fan
text: The lobby's right inside the lantern gate.

speaker: Lantern Keeper
text: Keep to the lanterns. The dark makes everything look bigger.

speaker: Scavenger
text: Abyss Rim is just back the way you came.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Lantern Pit! The arena is just ahead.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Void-types love the shadows in there. Watch out!

speaker: Fan
text: I brought my own lantern so I can see every move!

speaker: Drifter
text: The Wailing Cave is just through there. It's called that for a reason!

speaker: Drifter
text: Shade Hollows is back up the path.

speaker: Explorer
text: The wailing is just the wind. Probably.

speaker: Lantern Bearer
text: B1 of the Wailing Cave. Keep your lantern lit and your team close.

speaker: Lantern Bearer
text: The way down to B2 is past the moaning tunnel.

speaker: Spelunker
text: B2! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. The wailing gets louder down there!

speaker: Explorer
text: The Deep Chamber! The wailing stopped. That's either good or very spooky.

speaker: civilian
text: Lantern keeper: Every lantern on this street is tended by hand. Miss one night and the shadows creep in.

speaker: Scavenger
text: Trainers on these streets watch from the dark. Walk into their line of sight and they'll call you out.

speaker: Pilgrim
text: The Sinkhole is just east. They say a Signal Shard sleeps at the very bottom.

speaker: Drifter
text: Past the Sinkhole stands Gravewell Tower. The Keeper there fights with the dark itself.

speaker: Drifter
text: Mistfall Bend! The mist is so thick you can barely see your feet.

speaker: Drifter
text: Gloom Commons is just back the way you came.

speaker: Lantern Keeper
text: Hold your lantern high. The mist hides the path.

speaker: Scavenger
text: The Helix Hideout. They thought nobody could find it in the dark.

speaker: Scavenger
text: There's a lab in the back. Smells like burnt wires.

speaker: Lantern Keeper
text: The Relay Tower is close by. Follow the lanterns!

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: Who turned on the lights?! I was working in the dark on purpose.

speaker: Helix Scientist
text: Fine, look around. Just don't open the shadow jars.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Gloomshade Grove! Trees with black leaves that glow faintly.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Rare Void-types nap in the deep shadows here.

speaker: Lantern Keeper
text: I found this place off Abyss Fork. Keep your lantern close!

speaker: Lantern Maker
text: Welcome to the Lantern Maker's Shop! Every lantern here is handmade.

speaker: Lantern Maker
text: A good lantern keeps the dark away. And the Void-types guessing!

speaker: Customer
text: I'm buying a lantern for every room in my house. Even the closet.

speaker: Innkeeper
text: This is the Shadow Inn. Rest your feet and your team!

speaker: Innkeeper
text: The beds are soft and the lanterns stay on all night.

speaker: Traveller
text: I slept for twelve hours. The dark makes everyone sleepy!

speaker: Caretaker
text: This study belongs to someone who loves old books. Lots and lots of old books.

speaker: Caretaker
text: Please put things back where you found them. They notice.

speaker: Fan
text: The Gravewell Relay Tower! The lanterns around it never go out.

speaker: Fan
text: The trial floor waits inside, lit by a hundred lanterns.

speaker: Tower Guard
text: Void-types rule this tower. Bring your brightest team!

speaker: Resident
text: Gravewell Lane Homes. Every house has a lantern by the door.

speaker: Resident
text: Gravewell's just down the road.

speaker: Kid
text: I'm not scared of the dark! Okay, maybe a little.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Gravewell Quiet Court. The quietest spot in a very quiet world.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Even the shadows whisper here.

speaker: Neighbour
text: I polish my lantern every evening. It's my favorite chore.

speaker: Farmer
text: Umbra Farmstead Edge grows shadow mushrooms. They taste like midnight!

speaker: Farmer
text: Sinkhole Overlook is just up the path.

speaker: Farm Kid
text: My farm critters glow faintly in the dark. Makes them easy to find!

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Umbra Spaceport! Ships land by lantern light here.

speaker: Dock Tech
text: Shadow Junction is just past the gate.

speaker: Traveller
text: I came to see the lanterns. They're even prettier than the pictures!

speaker: Seeker
text: The Ancient Crystal Ring! Battles here echo through the crystal walls.

speaker: Seeker
text: The lobby is just through the shining arch.

speaker: Rift Walker
text: This ring is older than anything else on Ystra. Can you feel it?

speaker: Pilgrim
text: Glasswood Junction is just back the way you came.

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Crystal Ring! The arena is just ahead.

speaker: Receptionist
text: The crystals hum louder during big battles. Listen for it!

speaker: Fan
text: I came all the way from Halo to watch a match here!

speaker: Rift Walker
text: Shardheart Cave is just through there. The crystals inside are huge!

speaker: Rift Walker
text: Void Crack Bend is back up the path.

speaker: Seeker
text: Crystal-types guard the cave. Bring something strong!

speaker: Crystal Hunter
text: 1F of Shardheart Cave. The walls sparkle with every step.

speaker: Crystal Hunter
text: The way down to B1 is past the big crystal pillar.

speaker: Explorer
text: B1! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. The crystals glow brighter down there.

speaker: Seeker
text: The Deep Chamber! I've never seen crystals this big.

speaker: Rift Walker
text: Shard Slope! Crystal shards cover every step. Watch your feet!

speaker: Rift Walker
text: Red Sun Overlook is just back up the path.

speaker: Hiker
text: The shards ring like bells when the wind blows!

speaker: Wanderer
text: Ystra Secret Grove! Crystal trees that chime in the breeze.

speaker: Wanderer
text: Rare Alienmon nap under the glowing branches.

speaker: Seeker
text: I found this place off Void Fork. It feels very old.

speaker: Vault Keeper
text: The Seed Vault keeps seeds from every world. Every single one!

speaker: Vault Keeper
text: Please keep the doors closed. The seeds like it cool.

speaker: Researcher
text: I'm cataloguing seeds. Seed number 4,207 looks just like 4,206.

speaker: Caretaker
text: This Ancient Dwelling is older than anything else on Ystra.

speaker: Caretaker
text: Someone lived here long, long ago. They liked crystal furniture!

speaker: Memory Keeper
text: The Memory Hall holds echoes of all the worlds. Listen closely.

speaker: Memory Keeper
text: Some echoes are happy, some are sad. All are worth hearing.

speaker: Seeker
text: I came here to remember. I forgot what, though.

speaker: Nurse
text: Welcome to the Fragment Recovery Bay. Your team will feel brand new in no time.

speaker: Nurse
text: All rested! The crystals hum happily when Alienmon are healthy.

speaker: Visitor
text: My team napped right through the healing. Best rest ever!

speaker: Resident
text: Fragment Lane Homes are built on floating crystal pieces.

speaker: Resident
text: Crystal Crossroads is just down the path.

speaker: Kid
text: I found a crystal that sings! Wanna hear? La la la!

speaker: Neighbour
text: Arrival Fragment is close by if you just landed.

speaker: Old Resident
text: Fragment Quiet Court. The Recovery Bay and the shop are right here!

speaker: Old Resident
text: The crystals hum softly at night. Lovely sound.

speaker: Neighbour
text: I water my crystal garden every morning. They grow so slowly!

speaker: Farmer
text: Seedfall Farmstead grows plants from seeds that fell from the sky!

speaker: Farmer
text: Glasswood Hollows is just down the path.

text: Novaryx. Awakens when all 8 Signal Shards resonate; catchable before the crater.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Oblivane. The hungry moon-spirit of Ystra. It cannot be beaten, only calmed.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Seedmother. The living heart of Ystra, spoken of in every Ystran legend.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Cogglet. A single cog with one curious eye. Packs of them spin through Ferrox scrapyards looking for machines to fix.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Cyclopper. A copper scout that rolls on one wheel. Its single eye sees in the dark of the Deepcut Mine.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Girderon. A walking steel girder. Crane crews swear it holds up half the Railyard on its back.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Rustadillo. It curls into a ball of rusted plates and sleeps in scrap heaps. The rust is its armour.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Tinwing. A tin bird that lifts loose bolts with its crane-hook feet and rings like a bell when it sings.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Brineback. An old sea turtle carrying a reef on its shell. Fish follow it along the Thalassa coast.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Fiddlesnap. A crab with one giant claw that it snaps in rhythm. Dock workers call its clicking the harbour drum.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Squidmiral. A squid in a sailor hat who blows bubbles from a pipe. It reads the tides like a captain reads a chart.

speaker: Xenodex
text: The Old One. A whale older than the harbour. Sailors only glimpse its glowing fins far out where the sea goes dark.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Glowcroak. A frog with a glowing throat that sits on Sporeholm mushrooms and croaks light into the mist.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Gloomtoad. Its glow turns purple and bitter with age. It puffs spore bubbles that make other Alienmon drowsy.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Mossback. A turtle so still that a whole garden, waterfall and all, has grown on its shell.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Oozel. A grinning purple ooze that slides through the bogs, soaking up spores that would choke others.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Boombastadon. A mammoth built of speakers. When it stomps, the whole Neonis block feels the bass.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Squawkbox. A flying radio that picks up every signal in the city and squawks it back out of tune.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Puffloon. A pink cloud that floats over Halo on a ribbon. Touching it fills you with sleepy calm.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Stormquill. A bird made of lightning. Its feathers crackle, and storms over Halo follow its flight.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Lacefin. A seahorse with fins like lace that drifts through the flooded ruins of Glyphos.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Vitramoth. Its wings are stained glass. In the Temple of Voices it rests in the window frames and nobody notices.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Dunetrot. A sandstone dinosaur with a friendly grin. It naps in the sun until a sandstorm wakes it.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Hexcoil. A serpent dripping purple venom. Umbra lantern-keepers hang charms to keep it from their doors.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Rumbler. A golem of loose boulders. Pyros miners know a cave-in is coming when the Rumblers start walking.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Pebblet (Glacia). Pebblet's seedpod fell on Glacia long ago. Frost has crept into its cracks: the indigo crystals are now pale-blue ice, its brown stone is frosted white on top, and icicles hang from its edges.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Rivetoad (Helix). Rivetoad's seedpod fell on Helix Station long ago. Moss and tiny ferns grow between its rivets, a vine coils around one leg, and small glowing seed pods sprout along its back where bolts used to be.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Lumislug (Halo). Lumislug's seedpod fell on Halo long ago. Its glow pulses in rhythm like a speaker, its eyestalks end in little bell shapes, and its slime trail leaves faint ripples of sound.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Bubbub (Umbra). Bubbub's seedpod fell on Umbra long ago. Its bubble has turned smoky violet-black with tiny stars drifting inside, its flippers fade into wisps of shadow at the tips, and its happy grin glows faintly in the dark.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Bulbit (Starfall). Bulbit's seedpod fell on Starfall Rift long ago. Its bulb now holds a tiny swirling star of magenta plasma instead of electric light, with comet sparks trailing off it.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Monolet (Apex). Monolet's seedpod fell on Apex Array long ago. Its carved stone has turned into faceted see-through crystal that splits light into rainbows, its glyphs now glow like circuit lines, and a small prism spire grows from its top.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Ashpup (Ystra). Ashpup's seedpod fell on Ystra long ago. Its ash fur floats upward as if gravity is weaker around it, small rock fragments orbit its head, and its embers have cooled to deep indigo with starlight-silver flecks.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Snoblet (Dustara). Snoblet's seedpod fell on Dustara long ago. Its snow has turned to packed sand-gold dust, and a small swarm of glowing sand-bugs lives in it like snowflakes, buzzing around it in a cloud.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Vialit (Ferrox). Vialit's seedpod fell on Ferrox long ago. Its glass vial body is now riveted brass and copper with a pressure gauge on its side, pipes and valves replace its tubes, and its toxic liquid glows through small porthole windows.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Mindlet (Sporeholm). Mindlet's seedpod fell on Sporeholm long ago. Glowing purple-and-lime mushroom caps sprout from its head where its psychic halo was, toxic spores drift from it like thoughts, and its colours turn swampy violet and green.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Sulklet (Thalassa). Sulklet's seedpod fell on Thalassa long ago. Its shadow body has become deep ocean-blue water with bubbles rising through it, its sulky eyes glow like bioluminescent sea creatures, and a little fin curls from its back.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Novaling (Neonis). Novaling's seedpod fell on Neonis long ago. Its plasma flame has turned into crackling electric neon in yellow and cyan, outlined like a glowing sign, with small lightning arcs jumping off it.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Gemmling (Glyphos). Gemmling's seedpod fell on Glyphos long ago. Its gems have weathered into ancient violet crystal carved with glowing runes, a small third-eye gem opens on its brow, and two tiny rune rings float around it.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Riftling (Pyros). Riftling's seedpod fell on Pyros long ago. Its rift-energy has filled with molten lava: glowing orange cracks run through it, its edges are dark obsidian, and embers rise from it instead of floating debris.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Dunehound. A swarm of glowing sand-bugs drifts around it like a dust storm it carries everywhere.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Scarabane. A regal desert jackal in scarab armour. Its swarm forms a sun disc behind its head.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Rivethound. Gears and riveted plates cover it now. It sniffs out scrap the way other pups sniff out treats.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Forgewolf. A war-wolf of salvaged machinery with a furnace glowing in its chest.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Mirehound. Slime drips from its mushroom-cap ears. Swamp spores ride the air wherever it shakes itself.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Blightfang. A lanky swamp wolf with a toxic mushroom forest growing on its back.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Tidehound. Its light flows like water. Bubbles rise from it even on dry land.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Riptidal. A sea-wolf whose mane is a rushing wave that loops into a whirlpool.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Neonhound. Outlined like a neon sign, it crackles with static and hums when it is happy.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Neonfang. A sleek cyber-wolf traced with neon circuits, with a holographic tail.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Glyphhound. Old runes glow across its fur, and two rune rings circle it like a slow dance.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Glyphsphinx. A calm rune guardian, with stone tablets floating at its side.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Emberhound. Molten cracks glow through its obsidian body. Embers rise when it wags its tail.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Calderion. A huge volcano-wolf with a mane of rolling flame and lava dripping from its jaw.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Frosthound. Its crystal fur is cold to the touch, and snowflakes fall wherever it naps.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Glacierfang. A towering arctic wolf armoured in glacier ice, an aurora flowing from its mane.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Helixhound. A glowing double spiral runs down its back. Small leaves sprout where it walks.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Verdantrix. A graceful stag-wolf with vine antlers twisting in a living spiral.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Echohound. Its ears ring like bells, and sound ripples out from its chest when it barks.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Choirwing. A winged sky-hound whose wings are made of sound waves.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Shadehound. A void swirls in its chest. Only its star-point eyes show in the dark.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Nightcrown. A looming eclipse-wolf crowned by a black sun ringed with silver light.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Novahound. It streams plasma like a comet, too excited to ever stand still.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Starmane. A radiant comet-wolf with a bright star burning in its chest.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Prismhound. Light splits into rainbows through its crystal body.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Arraylith. A towering crystal guardian with prism spires rising from its spine.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Orbithound. Small rocks orbit it, and it walks a hair above the ground.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Worldwarden. An ancient guardian carrying a floating piece of the lost world Ystra.
